title.en: Katsudon from Pan to Bowl
title.ja: かつ丼ができるまで

summary.en: An animated cooking sequence uses food texture and fast insert shots.
summary.ja: 調理の質感を寄りのカットでつなぐアニメ。

entries.prompt: Animate a katsudon preparation from an overhead kitchen view. Cut in for crumbs on the cutlet, oil bubbling at the pan edge and egg spreading around the sliced meat. Finish with the ingredients settling onto a rice bowl and steam rising. Keep the bowl placement and warm kitchen light consistent. Let chopping, frying and bowl sounds mark the cuts.

title.en: Fishing Village Boat Rescue
title.ja: 漁村のボート救助

summary.en: A fictional storm rescue tracks one boat through widening shots.
summary.ja: 架空の嵐の救助を、一隻のボートと広がる画角で追う。

entries.prompt: Set a fictional rescue in a coastal fishing village. Open on a small boat leaving the landing as dark water moves beyond the harbor wall. Follow close to a rescuer in a waterproof jacket, then cut wide as the boat reaches people waiting above the flood line. Keep their positions readable from shot to shot and use wind and water to build tension.

title.en: A Black Outfit in a Moving Crowd
title.ja: 人波の中の黒い衣装

summary.en: A fashion reel isolates its subject by controlling distance and the motion around her.
summary.ja: 距離と周囲の動きで主役を際立たせるファッション映像。

entries.prompt: Use your own opening image of a fictional model in a black outfit among a crowd. Begin on a slow walk into the center of the group. Change from a wide angle to a shoulder-level close-up while the background keeps moving. Hold one pose as the people pass around it. Preserve the silhouette and outfit across the cuts and use soft street lighting.

title.en: Venice Folds into a Sphere
title.ja: ヴェネツィアの街が球体へ折りたたまれる

summary.en: A moving city view shows architecture bending without losing its landmarks.
summary.ja: 街の画角を動かしながら、目印を保って建築が曲がる様子を見せる。

entries.prompt: Set a surreal walk in Venice. Let the camera follow an adult with a satchel through a narrow street and begin to rise as nearby façades curve into the view. Keep bridges and window lines identifiable while the streets fold toward a sphere. End wide enough to see the new shape and the old layout together.

title.en: Two Strangers Reach for One Book
title.ja: 同じ本に手を伸ばす二人

summary.en: A rainy bookstore encounter leads into a short shared walk.
summary.ja: 雨の日の書店での出会いから、二人で歩く場面につなぐ。

entries.prompt: Open with rain on the window of a small bookstore. Follow an adult down one aisle and cut close as two people reach for the same volume. Hold a beat on their surprised reactions. Move to a shot outside with both under one umbrella, then end on two cups on a café table. Use the rain as an audio bridge.

title.en: A Photograph That Won’t Stay Still
title.ja: 止まっていない古い写真

summary.en: Close-ups of a photo and a photographer establish a quiet mystery.
summary.ja: 古い写真と撮影者の接写で静かな謎を作る。

entries.prompt: Place a photographer alone in a quiet room with an old photograph. Begin close on the print as it is lifted into desk light. Show one small movement inside the image while the paper itself stays still. Cut to the photographer noticing, then back to a slightly different detail on the print. Use a restrained push-in and a soft room tone.

title.en: Branches Meet Glass in an Empty Room
title.ja: 空室で出会う木の枝とガラス

summary.en: Contrasting surfaces and slow blocking give two abstract figures a readable encounter.
summary.ja: 異なる素材とゆっくりした配置で二体の出会いを見せる。

entries.prompt: Set two fantasy figures in an empty vintage room. One is built from intertwined roots; the other catches iridescent light like thin glass. Establish the distance between them, then move closer as they approach and pause at arm’s length. Let the lighting reveal the difference between bark and glass. Keep the camera and gestures slow enough to read.

title.en: A Formal Outfit on the Family Sofa
title.ja: 家族のソファで正装する父

summary.en: A toddler’s reactions offset a father’s formal posture in a warm room.
summary.ja: 暖かい部屋で、父の正装と幼い子の反応を対比する。

entries.prompt: Stage a short 3D animated scene in a living room lit from the side. A father in a formal black suit sits very straight beside his toddler. Alternate his controlled pose with the child leaning closer and pointing at a shiny accessory. Let the adult’s expression crack into a smile before ending on both in one frame.

title.en: Patent Heels Across Four Surfaces
title.ja: 四つの床で見せるエナメルの靴

summary.en: Changes in floor material show how the same footwear catches light.
summary.ja: 床材が変わると同じ靴の光り方が変わる。

entries.prompt: Show a pair of unbranded black patent heels walking from a glossy studio surface into a lit corridor. Match the step into a nighttime pavement view and then polished marble. Cut close to the straps and moving reflections before a neutral product shot. Keep the same shoe geometry throughout.

title.en: A Skateboard Doodle Crosses a Desk
title.ja: 机を滑る手描きスケーター

summary.en: A hand-drawn rider stays integrated with a real desk through changes in height and framing.
summary.ja: 手描きのスケーターを机の高さや画角の変化になじませる。

entries.prompt: Put a tiny hand-drawn skater in an orange shirt onto a real office desk. Track at the level of the board as it rolls past pens and notebooks, then rise slightly as the skater turns an office supply into a ramp. Give the drawn figure shadows that follow the desk light and keep the desk objects solid. Let the sound of rolling wheels and a short landing mark the motion. Close with a wide reveal of the desk.

title.en: A Travel Vlog from Aisle to Window Seat
title.ja: 通路から窓側の座席までの旅Vlog

summary.en: An everyday airplane sequence moves from aisle tracking to a quieter window composition.
summary.ja: 機内通路の追い撮りから、窓側の落ち着いた画角へと切り替える。

entries.prompt: Make a short travel vlog inside a passenger plane. Track an adult walking down the aisle with a small shoulder bag, keeping the seats and overhead bins aligned. Cut closer as she reaches her row and sits at the window. End from just behind her shoulder with the view and cabin reflections visible in the glass. Keep exposure natural as the camera turns toward the bright window. Use soft cabin sounds and small movements from other passengers.

title.en: Glitter Polish at Toddler Height
title.ja: 子どもの目線で見るラメのネイル

summary.en: A small animated mishap plays through visible hands, props and reactions.
summary.ja: 手、道具、表情で見せる小さなアニメの失敗。

entries.prompt: Frame a playful 3D animation at the height of a small child sitting by a low table. Start with the glitter polish bottle catching the light, then show the child inspecting her fingers and reacting to the sparkle. Cut briefly to a parent noticing the activity before returning to a close view of the glitter. Keep the pacing light and the props in the same places.

title.en: From Alarm Clock to Streetwear
title.ja: 目覚ましから街のファッションへ

summary.en: A fashion diary uses close details to connect the bedroom and the street.
summary.ja: 細部の寄りで部屋からストリートへつなぐファッション日記。

entries.prompt: Open on a vibrating phone by the bed. Cut from the hand reaching for it to a few quick details of an adult getting dressed, then follow the finished look into a Seoul street. Alternate the pace of close-up object cuts and longer street shots. Keep the outfit consistent after the reveal and use everyday sounds to join the rooms.

title.en: Garlic and a Parrot in a Ship’s Galley
title.ja: 船の厨房のニンニクとオウム

summary.en: A lantern-lit cooking comedy uses cooking sounds and a parrot’s timing.
summary.ja: ランタンを灯した料理コメディを、調理音とオウムの間で見せる。

entries.prompt: Animate a small ship galley under warm lanterns. A green parrot edges toward a bulb of garlic while the cook prepares ingredients. Cut close to the parrot’s pause, the rhythmic chopping and the loud sizzle when the pan heats. Let an ordinary pot clatter interrupt the parrot’s approach for a light comic beat.

title.en: A Tiny Laundry-Day Adventure
title.ja: 小さな洗濯日の冒険

summary.en: Macro framing turns a familiar laundry room into an oversized set.
summary.ja: マクロの画角で洗濯室を巨大な舞台に変える。

entries.prompt: Set a tiny fictional character loose in a full-size laundry room. Track along a fold of fabric, show a laundry basket looming from below and follow past a washer door at tabletop height. Keep the person tiny relative to the fabric weave and handles. Use quiet appliance sounds and close texture to establish scale.

title.en: A Green Bridal Gown in Castle Gardens
title.ja: 城の庭の緑の婚礼ドレス

summary.en: Portraits and wide garden views show the shape and texture of a bridal gown.
summary.ja: 庭園の引き画と人物の寄りで、婚礼衣装の形と質感を見せる。

entries.prompt: Frame a bridal editorial around an embroidered pale-green gown in a castle garden. Open in a wide symmetrical path, then move closer to show embroidery and the veil lifting in the wind. Return to a full-length view so the veil and dress can settle naturally. Hold the same light and outfit from shot to shot.

title.en: Five Looks in a Midnight Loop
title.ja: 真夜中に巡る五つの装い

summary.en: A recurring foreground shape turns a five-look fashion reel into a loop.
summary.ja: 繰り返す前景を使って五つの装いをループ映像にする。

entries.prompt: Begin a vertical fashion reel low behind a dark velvet chaise. Let its blurred edge cover the frame, then reveal five different looks in short, evenly timed sections. Use the same camera direction as each change crosses the foreground. End behind the same edge at the original camera height and speed so playback can loop cleanly.

title.en: A Miniature Run Through a Corner Shop
title.ja: 小さな主人公のコンビニ横断

summary.en: A macro tracking sequence makes shelves and a checkout conveyor read like a large set.
summary.ja: 棚やレジのベルトを巨大な舞台に見せるマクロ撮影。

entries.prompt: Follow a tiny adventurer through a full-size convenience store. Track low along a shelf as packets crinkle underfoot, then shift to a moving cart and a checkout conveyor that fills the frame. Keep the person's size stable relative to labels and handles. Finish with a pullback from a high display to reveal the whole store and its normal-sized shoppers. Use foreground parallax and everyday shop sounds.

title.en: A Morning Stretch with Mom
title.ja: お母さんと朝のストレッチ

summary.en: Warm morning light and contrasting poses guide a family animation.
summary.ja: 朝の光と二人の異なるポーズで見せる家族のアニメ。

entries.prompt: Create a cozy 3D animated living room with warm morning light. Show a mother stretching on a mat and her baby trying to imitate one easy pose. Cut from both characters in the same frame to their different expressions as the child wobbles. Keep the mood gentle, the room steady and the movements simple.

title.en: A Blue Mecha Lands in a Neon City
title.ja: ネオンの街に降りる青いメカ

summary.en: A wide landing and spreading dust establish the scale of a fictional creature encounter.
summary.ja: 広い着地カットと舞う砂ぼこりで、怪物との距離と大きさを見せる。

entries.prompt: Stage a fictional mecha encounter in a futuristic street. Establish the skyline and a giant creature before a blue robot drops into the foreground. Show dust spreading outward at street level, then cut wide enough to hold both figures in silhouette. Use the pause after the landing to establish their scale and separation.

title.en: A Chilled Fruit Snack on a Summer Afternoon
title.ja: 夏の午後に冷たい果物のおやつ

summary.en: A quiet kitchen sequence stays close to fruit and condensation.
summary.ja: 静かな台所で果物と結露に寄る。

entries.prompt: In a bright kitchen on a hot afternoon, follow a fictional cook preparing a simple cold fruit snack. Begin with a wide counter view, then cut close to fruit being sliced and moisture on a chilled bowl. Hold a final view of the finished snack beside the window. Let room sounds and the cold surface texture carry the scene.

title.en: Tennis Cuts on Contact
title.ja: 打球の瞬間でつなぐテニス映像

summary.en: Short handheld views make ball contact the timing cue for the next cut.
summary.ja: 短い手持ちショットを打球の瞬間で切り替える。

entries.prompt: Create a fast tennis reel in clear midday light. Establish one athlete and court, then alternate quick views of a step, racket movement and ball contact. Return wide often enough to see the ball’s direction. Keep the same shadows and costume, and cut on the contact sounds or footfalls.

title.en: A Floating Palace Above the Clouds
title.ja: 雲の上に浮かぶ宮殿

summary.en: Bridges, waterfalls and a walking figure give a cloudscape depth.
summary.ja: 橋、滝、歩く人物を配置し、雲の風景に奥行きを出す。

entries.prompt: Glide toward a palace complex suspended above clouds at sunset. Pass a bridge carrying one robed figure, then let the camera rise past columns and falling water to reveal the surrounding kingdom. Use a distant moon and a few cranes to show depth. Keep the architecture coherent as the clouds move behind it.

title.en: Early-Morning Yoga on a Terrace
title.ja: 屋上テラスの朝ヨガ

summary.en: An old camcorder treatment frames a small routine on a residential rooftop.
summary.ja: 家庭用カメラの質感で、住宅の屋上での日課を撮る。

entries.prompt: Use your own frame of an adult and yoga mat on a plain rooftop terrace. Set the camera at a casual distance and correct the framing slightly as the routine begins. Cut to feet on the mat and then back to the full posture. Keep the potted plants and morning shadows consistent. Use quiet street noise and faded camcorder color.

title.en: A Grocery Trip in Seven Small Shots
title.ja: 七つのカットで見る買い物

summary.en: A shopping vlog uses repeated props and short actions to establish continuity.
summary.ja: 買い物の小物と短い動作で場面をつなぐVlog。

entries.prompt: Start from your own image of a fictional shopper at a grocery entrance. Follow the same bag and outfit through an aisle, close-ups of products being selected and a short checkout shot. Keep each action easy to follow before switching angles. Use the sound of a cart rolling and scanner tones instead of continuous narration.

title.en: A Dragon Steals Dinner
title.ja: ドラゴンに夕食を取られる

summary.en: A fantasy short stages the surprise around a person, a meal and one hungry visitor.
summary.ja: 食事と空腹の来客を軸にしたファンタジーのコメディ。

entries.prompt: Open on an adult preparing a simple meal in warm late-day light. Keep the plate in the foreground as a small dragon comes into view from behind it. Let the dragon take a bite or carry the food away, then hold on the person’s delayed reaction. End with both characters visible so the joke reads without narration.

title.en: Sun and Shade in a Spanish Travel Diary
title.ja: スペイン旅日記の光と影

summary.en: Mediterranean light connects close travel details and a broader streetscape.
summary.ja: 地中海の日差しで旅先の細部と街並みをつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Use an original starting image of a fictional traveler in a Spanish street. Move from shade under an arcade into bright sun, then cut to architectural details and a wider walking view. Keep the same traveler and pace across the sequence. Use warm light, textured walls and local street ambience to carry the changes of angle.

title.en: A Phoenix Rises over a Floating Kingdom
title.ja: 浮遊する王国に昇る不死鳥

summary.en: The fantasy reveal layers castles, clouds and two large creatures.
summary.ja: 城、雲、二体の大きな生き物を重ねるファンタジーの演出。

entries.prompt: Open on stone castles above mountains and clouds. Pull past a robed figure as a blue dragon glides through the gap below. Hold the dragon low in frame while a bright phoenix rises above the skyline. Let the two movements cross at different depths, with wind and moving cloud keeping the scale clear.

title.en: A Village in Old Tuscany
title.ja: 昔のトスカーナの村

summary.en: A rural period vignette pairs warm light with the texture of a home-video camera.
summary.ja: 家庭用カメラの質感と暖かい光で描く昔の田園風景。

entries.prompt: Set a fictional home-video vignette in rural Tuscany in the late nineteenth century. Follow an adult in a linen blouse and worn apron as she crosses a path between stone buildings. Move closer for work-worn fabric and a small everyday gesture, then pull back to show the valley. Keep period objects in frame and use low sun and understated handheld motion.

title.en: A Lantern Leads to a Snowy Cabin
title.ja: ランタンが導く雪の山小屋

summary.en: Cool moonlight and a warm doorway mark the transition from forest to cabin.
summary.ja: 冷たい月明かりと暖かい玄関の光で森から小屋へつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Follow a red-jacketed traveler carrying a lantern through a snowy forest at night. Walk close enough to see its warm light pass across branches and snow. Establish a small cabin ahead. When the door opens, let its warm interior light replace the blue outside light and reveal a white dog inside. Finish on the threshold with the two color temperatures visible.

title.en: A Blue Pencil Draws the City
title.ja: 青い鉛筆で街を描き変える

summary.en: A pencil stroke carries real movement into hand-drawn lines across a series of city views.
summary.ja: 鉛筆の線をきっかけに、街の動きを実写から手描きに変える。

entries.prompt: Show a city in first person. A hand lifts a blue pencil and traces the body of a passing train. Let the train become animated line art while its speed and perspective continue. Repeat the idea with a tabby on the sidewalk and a pastel bus. Keep the transformations local to the area the pencil touches and preserve the framing just before and after each change. Use ordinary daylight and let the street sounds run through the transitions.

title.en: Late-Night Snacks in Korea
title.ja: 韓国の夜食Vlog

summary.en: A vertical street diary follows two friends through a warmly lit food stop.
summary.ja: 二人の友人が夜食を選ぶ様子を縦型の街映像で追う。

entries.prompt: Film two friends on a Korean street at night from a casual handheld viewpoint. Follow them toward a bright food stall, then cut to steam and a small exchange at the counter. Hold close as they taste the snack and share a smile before walking away. Use reflections, small autofocus shifts and ordinary street sounds.

title.en: An Amber Fragrance Under Warm Light
title.ja: 暖かな光に浮かぶ琥珀色の香水

summary.en: A perfume spot shifts from a portrait to glass and liquid highlights.
summary.ja: 人物のポートレートからガラスと液体の輝きに移る香水広告。

entries.prompt: Open in warm side light on a person holding an unlabeled fragrance bottle. Cut to a macro shot of amber liquid and the edge of the glass. Turn the bottle slowly so reflections move across its shape without hiding it. Close on a simple packshot against dark wood and soft bokeh, keeping the bottle consistent.

title.en: Dancing in Autumn Kyoto
title.ja: 秋の京都で踊る二人

summary.en: Two dancers share a daylight frame while leaves and fabric remain visible in motion.
summary.ja: 日中の画角で二人の踊りと、落ち葉や布の動きを見せる。

entries.prompt: Stage a short outdoor dance for two fictional performers in autumn Kyoto. Establish both bodies in a daylight wide shot, then move to a side angle as they travel together. Use one closer view for fabric and hands and end in a composition with falling leaves behind both dancers. Keep the spacing and direction stable throughout the cut.

title.en: A Rainforest Panther Transformation
title.ja: 雨林の黒ヒョウへの変化

summary.en: Eye, silhouette and ground-level shots bridge a fictional creature transformation.
summary.ja: 目、シルエット、地面の高さのカットで架空の変身をつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Set a fictional transformation in a misty rainforest. Start wide on a lone character crouching by wet leaves. Cut to the eyes as the light changes and then to an overhead silhouette. Move down to the leaf level as two black paws settle into place. Reveal a panther with no extra limbs or duplicate silhouettes, using steady forest ambience through the changes.

title.en: An Alpine Morning in Switzerland
title.ja: スイスの山あいの朝

summary.en: An aerial valley reveal leads into lakeside and campsite details in a travel sequence.
summary.ja: 谷の空撮から湖畔やキャンプの細部へとつなぐ旅の映像。

entries.prompt: Open high over mist in a Swiss valley, letting the cliffs and waterfalls emerge as the camera glides forward. Cut to a walker beside a clear alpine lake. Lower the camera for the campsite details: a pale tent, wildflowers and steam above a cup. Use the changing distance from landscape to person to make the place feel lived in. Keep daylight natural and let water and wind connect the scenes.

title.en: A Kitten at the Rainy Window
title.ja: 雨の窓の外にいる子猫

summary.en: A cooking scene changes direction when the subject sees a kitten outdoors.
summary.ja: 調理中の人物が外の子猫に気づく場面で話が動く。

entries.prompt: Begin on a pan of spaghetti in a warm kitchen. Move to the cook looking toward heavy rain at the window, then cut outside to a small kitten keeping low near the house. Follow the cook returning with the kitten wrapped in a towel. Keep rain audible at the window as the light becomes warmer and the kitten settles.

title.en: A Snowy Walk in Painted Motion
title.ja: 雪の街を歩く手描きの二人

summary.en: A winter couple keeps moving through soft illustrated backgrounds.
summary.ja: 冬の街を動き続ける二人を柔らかな絵で描く。

entries.prompt: Use an original painted street frame as the visual starting point. Follow two adults walking through falling snow. Cut to their hands and to a turn at a corner while both keep moving, then pull back as they pass under street lights. Give the camera a gentle drift in every shot and use footsteps and winter street ambience.

title.en: Midnight Headlights on Wet Asphalt
title.ja: 濡れた路面を照らす深夜のヘッドライト

summary.en: A low entry shot and matched side tracking introduce a white car at night.
summary.ja: 低い入りのカットと横の追走で、夜の白い車を見せる。

entries.prompt: Open at pavement height as a white coupe emerges slowly from a garage at midnight. Hold the headlights reflected in the wet road before revealing the whole vehicle. Cut to a smooth side track on the quiet boulevard and then to a wider view of the city lights. Keep the pace controlled and the front light consistent between angles.

title.en: A Toddler’s Royal Dress-Up
title.ja: 小さな子のお姫さまごっこ

summary.en: The dresser, mirror and family reactions define the short animation.
summary.ja: 鏡台と家族の反応で見せる着せ替えの短いアニメ。

entries.prompt: Animate a toddler playing at being royalty in a softly lit dressing room. Two older children help her choose an outfit while an adult watches in amusement. Move from the dresser to a medium shot as the toddler turns toward the mirror with exaggerated dignity. End with the helpers smiling behind her and keep their reflections aligned.

title.en: From a Morning Walk to Backyard Fetch
title.ja: 朝の散歩から庭で遊ぶ時間まで

summary.en: A dog and owner stay consistent across a simple day-long montage.
summary.ja: 犬と飼い主を保ちながら、日常の一日を短くつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Open on an adult greeting a golden-brown dog in morning light. Cut to a bowl, a short walk and the dog resting nearby while the owner works. Finish in the backyard with one playful fetch at golden hour. Keep the dog’s markings and natural movement consistent and let the ambient sound change with the time of day.

title.en: A Taiwanese Summer Evening on Tape
title.ja: テープに残る台湾の夏の夕暮れ

summary.en: A softly colored camcorder look gives the ordinary evening a sense of place.
summary.ja: 家庭用カメラの柔らかな色で台湾の夏の夕暮れを描く。

entries.prompt: Create a fictional personal video of an ordinary Taiwanese summer evening. Let the camera follow a young adult out into the neighborhood, alternating shoulder-height walking shots and small details along the way. Use warm fading daylight, slight tape softness and understated exposure shifts. Keep the noise of the street present under the entire scene.

title.en: A Broom Ride over the Korean Countryside
title.ja: 韓国の風景をほうきで飛ぶ

summary.en: An imaginary flight starts at courtyard level and opens onto a broad landscape.
summary.ja: 中庭の低い画角から広い景色へ飛び出す架空の飛行。

entries.prompt: Start low in a stone courtyard as a fictional rider in an orange dress begins flying on a broom. Track briefly alongside at foot height, then pull back into a wider view as she crosses the countryside. Keep her direction of travel clear through the angle changes. Let wind move the fabric and use distant mountains to give depth.

title.en: A Forest Turns into a 3D Fantasy World
title.ja: 森が3Dのファンタジー世界になる

summary.en: A luminous mushroom cues a change in style and space.
summary.ja: 光るキノコを合図に画風と空間が変わる。

entries.prompt: Start in a natural-looking forest in late-afternoon light. Follow a traveler discovering a glowing mushroom. Keep the camera on the same path as its light becomes a portal and the forest changes into a stylized 3D world. Preserve the traveler’s motion and main colors through the change so the transition feels continuous.

title.en: A Dragon Appears Above a Medieval City
title.ja: 中世の街の上に現れるドラゴン

summary.en: Bird movement and people looking up set up a large aerial reveal.
summary.ja: 飛び立つ鳥と見上げる人々で大きな空の登場を予告する。

entries.prompt: Set a short fantasy scene on a busy medieval street. Let birds lift suddenly from the rooftops as the crowd looks up. Tilt from street height to find a large dragon emerging behind the castle towers. Cut wide as it crosses the city, leaving moving cloth and dust below to convey its presence and scale.

title.en: Golden-Hour FPV over Tokyo
title.ja: 黄金色の東京を抜けるFPV

summary.en: A moving viewpoint reveals glass towers, intersections and layers of the city.
summary.ja: 動く視点でガラスの高層ビル、交差点、街の奥行きを見せる。

entries.prompt: Create an imagined FPV shot above Tokyo at golden hour. Start between glass towers, glide past reflections and open out over a busy intersection. Use a gradual bank to reveal the next layers of buildings. Keep the horizon and direction readable, with warm edges on the glass and changing city ambience as the camera moves.

title.en: A Halloween Morning in Seoul
title.ja: ソウルのハロウィーンの朝

summary.en: A phone-calendar insert anchors a short holiday diary in an apartment.
summary.ja: スマートフォンの日付が、部屋から始まる休日Vlogのきっかけになる。

entries.prompt: Open in a Seoul apartment as morning light reaches the bed on Halloween. Cut close to a phone calendar, then follow an adult getting ready in a mirror. Use a few unhurried movements before moving outside with one small seasonal detail in the street. Keep the outfit consistent and leave the scene mostly to room and street sound.

title.en: Strawberries and Ganache in a Pastry Editorial
title.ja: イチゴとガナッシュの菓子作り映像

summary.en: Cutting, piping and pouring each get a short macro view.
summary.ja: 切る、絞る、注ぐ動きを短い接写で見せる。

entries.prompt: Film a pastry chef finishing a chocolate layer cake in a kitchen lit by sunset. Cut close to strawberries being sliced, cream landing between layers and ganache moving over the top. Keep the cake centered and the hands readable from each angle. End on a steady view of the finished decoration.

title.en: One Pump of a Cosmetic Cream
title.ja: クリームをひと押し

summary.en: The pump, the drop and the tube each get a clear product shot.
summary.ja: ポンプ、ひと滴、チューブを順に見せる商品カット。

entries.prompt: Set an unbranded white cosmetic tube against a warm neutral background. Start medium as a hand presents it toward camera, then cut to the thumb pressing the pump and the cream forming a small bead. Move into a macro view that holds the texture briefly. Finish on a centered tube with soft reflections.

title.en: Blue Perfume Glass at the Shore
title.ja: 海辺の青い香水瓶

summary.en: Sea reflections and a dissolve link a bottle’s color to the beach.
summary.ja: 海の反射とディゾルブでボトルの色を浜辺につなぐ。

entries.prompt: Place a blue glass perfume bottle on a wet rock beside gentle waves at sunset. Move in slowly as droplets and warm reflections cross the glass. Dissolve to a wider shore view with soft white fabric moving in the distance. Return to the blue bottle for a simple closing frame with the sea still audible.

title.en: An Empty Fortress on Security Cameras
title.ja: 監視カメラで見る空城の計

summary.en: Fixed viewpoints and a continuous timestamp sell an absurd alternate-history scene.
summary.ja: 固定の画角と途切れない時刻表示で、架空の歴史コメディを見せる。

entries.prompt: 拍一段架空的三国喜剧。用三台黑白固定广角监控拍同一座空城：城门内有人扫地，城楼上的文士用笔记本摆弄几架小飞行器，城外的将士看到后迟疑离开。切机位时保留同一条道路和连续递增的时间戳。画面有低分辨率、暗角和轻微扫描线。演员表情保持严肃，让古装场景和突兀的现代道具形成笑点。

title.en: A Pastel Korean Street-Fashion Reel
title.ja: パステル色の韓国ストリートファッション

summary.en: A vertical fashion reel shows how to keep an outfit consistent across a walk and close-up details.
summary.ja: 歩きと寄りのカットをつなぎ、衣装を保つ縦型のファッション映像。

entries.prompt: Frame a pastel street-style reel on a Korean neighborhood street. Introduce the model in a full-body walk wearing an oversized pink hoodie, a dark pleated skirt and white socks. Cut closer to catch a silver earring, the knit cuff and the movement of the hem, then return to a matching walking angle. Keep the outfit intact through the cuts. Use soft daylight and shallow focus with gentle city ambience.

title.en: A Gym Diary Shot on an Old Camcorder
title.ja: 古いビデオカメラ風のジム日記

summary.en: Floor and bench angles give a casual workout vlog visual variety.
summary.ja: 床やベンチからの画角を使った気軽な運動Vlog。

entries.prompt: Create a short gym diary filmed in the style of an older consumer camcorder. Alternate a handheld introduction with steady angles from the floor and a bench as a fictional adult moves around a dumbbell workout. Keep close shots short and let the room, shoes and equipment provide the sound. Retain slight focus shifts and soft highlights.

title.en: A Neighborhood Barbershop in 1948
title.ja: 1948年の街の理髪店

summary.en: Period props and everyday gestures build the feel of a small barbershop.
summary.ja: 時代の小道具と日常の身振りで小さな理髪店を描く。

entries.prompt: Set a fictional scene in an American neighborhood barbershop in 1948. Begin outside on the doorway and a customer entering. Cut to a worn barber chair, metal grooming tools and the barber setting a cape in place. Hold briefly on two customers waiting in soft window light. Make the props and clothes fit the era, and use quiet room chatter.

title.en: A Farmer Before Sunrise
title.ja: 日の出前の農作業

summary.en: Soil and hands connect the early field work to a sunrise wide shot.
summary.ja: 土と手元を使い、早朝の作業から日の出の引き画へつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Start before sunrise with a farmer walking toward a field in South Asia carrying a hand tool. Show a few simple work movements from a grounded side angle. Cut close to soil falling between the fingers, then open out to the field and the first sunlight. Let birds, earth and footsteps fill the soundtrack.

title.en: A Cherry Blossom Picnic in Seoul
title.ja: ソウルの桜の下でピクニック

summary.en: A park diary follows petals, picnic details and a spring walking shot.
summary.ja: 花びらとピクニックの細部、春の散歩をつなぐ公園Vlog。

entries.prompt: Follow a fictional visitor wearing a cream cardigan through a Seoul park during cherry blossom season. Move from a path under the trees to hands setting up a simple picnic. Return to a wider view with petals moving across the frame. Keep the same clothes and bag, and let the park ambience connect the cuts.

title.en: A Pink Skincare Jar in a Bedroom Vlog
title.ja: 部屋のVlogで見せるピンクの容器

summary.en: A handheld product demo balances a quick portrait and a close look at the jar.
summary.ja: 人物の寄りと容器の接写を組み合わせた手持ちの商品紹介。

entries.prompt: Start with your own frame of a fictional creator holding a pink skincare jar in a bright bedroom. Move the jar toward the camera for a label-free close-up, then cut to the lid and the cream’s texture. Return to the same framing for a brief reaction. Keep the product and clothes consistent and the light natural.

title.en: Two Skydivers Above a Sea of Clouds
title.ja: 雲海の上で舞う二人のスカイダイバー

summary.en: The fictional aerial scene contrasts close figures and distant movement in the sky.
summary.ja: 架空の空中シーンで近くの人物と遠景の動きを対比する。

entries.prompt: Create a fictional skydiving film high over a sea of clouds. Show two performers moving in the foreground while a bright exhaust trail rises far behind them. Change from a close tracking view to a wide shot that preserves their relative positions. Use quiet sections of wind and keep the horizon stable enough to read.

title.en: A Café Vlog That Keeps Going Wrong
title.ja: うまくいかないカフェVlog

summary.en: Small framing mistakes and delayed reactions become the joke.
summary.ja: 画角の小さな失敗と遅れた反応を笑いに使う。

entries.prompt: Make a fictional selfie-style café diary where an adult tries to record a polished clip. Let the angle drift, then show her resetting the cup and trying again. Use one small interruption and hold on the moment she starts laughing. Keep the location and lighting steady while letting the framing feel improvised.

title.en: Wool Coats and Autumn Manhattan
title.ja: 秋のマンハッタンのウールコート

summary.en: Passing taxis, leaves and a steady outfit establish the street editorial.
summary.ja: タクシーと落ち葉、変わらない衣装で街のファッションを見せる。

entries.prompt: Follow a fictional model in a camel coat and cream scarf down a Manhattan sidewalk in autumn. Keep golden leaves and taxis in the background without losing the silhouette. Cut closer to the coat texture when the subject pauses near a corner, then return to a wider view as she moves into the street scene.

title.en: A First Digital Camera in 2003
title.ja: 2003年、初めてのデジタルカメラ

summary.en: A period vlog follows a purchase, a blurry selfie and the trip home.
summary.ja: 購入からぼけた自撮り、自宅までを追う時代物のVlog。

entries.prompt: Make a fictional 2003 MiniDV diary about buying a first compact digital camera. Start at the shop counter, then show the new owner trying the controls and taking a slightly blurry selfie. End on the trip home with the box in frame. Use the old camcorder’s softness, uneven framing and ordinary shop sounds.

title.en: A Robot Kneels in a Rainy Village
title.ja: 雨の村でひざをつくロボット

summary.en: A tiny tabletop prop sets up the arrival of a much larger robot.
summary.ja: 卓上の小さなロボットをきっかけに巨大なロボットを登場させる。

entries.prompt: Open on a white daisy and a little mechanical spider on a café table in a rainy village square. Show a purple-cloaked child studying it. Rack focus to a giant robot emerging through the mist, then use a wide angle as it kneels to meet the child’s eye level. Keep rain audible under the quiet reactions.

title.en: A Character Dreams of Flight
title.ja: 飛ぶことを夢見る主人公

summary.en: An expressive animated short builds from interior close-ups to a wider release.
summary.ja: 室内の接写から開けた画角へ広がるアニメ。

entries.prompt: Animate a short story about a character who longs to fly. Begin in a small interior and stay close on a discouraged look and hands picking up an object linked to that dream. Gradually move to wider shots as she decides to act. End in open light with more air around the figure and a change in posture that shows her resolve.

title.en: A Wok Toss in an Animated Kitchen
title.ja: アニメの厨房で中華鍋を振る

summary.en: A chef’s movement motivates a sharp cut to light and rising food.
summary.ja: 料理人の動きで火と食材の寄りに切り替える。

entries.prompt: Set a short 3D animated sequence in a restaurant kitchen. Start medium on a chef moving an iron wok, then cut close as the ingredients lift and catch the warm light. Return to a calmer angle as the food returns to the pan. Use the metal, firelight and the cook’s rhythm to connect the shots.

title.en: Liquid Metal Forms a Sports Car
title.ja: 液体金属がスポーツカーになる

summary.en: A single transformation keeps the garage fixed while the vehicle assembles.
summary.ja: ガレージを固定し、車体が組み上がる変化を見せる。

entries.prompt: In a dim concrete garage, begin close on a pool of dark liquid metal. Let it rise and form the chassis, then build the panels around the same silhouette. Keep the floor markings and lighting fixed throughout the change. Pull out into a slow orbit as the headlights appear and the finished sports car settles into place.

title.en: Three Manicure Finishes in Macro
title.ja: 三つのネイルをマクロで見る

summary.en: A dark studio highlights differences in gloss, pearlescence and chrome.
summary.ja: 暗いスタジオで光沢、パール、クロームの違いを見せる。

entries.prompt: Start with one hand against a dark studio background. Bring in a soft key light and tilt the hand slightly, letting the highlight pass across a glossy pink nail. Cut to pearlescent and chrome finishes at the same magnification. Keep finger position believable and hold each texture long enough to compare.

title.en: The Spider in the Family Kitchen
title.ja: 家族の台所に現れたクモ

summary.en: A sequence of reaction shots builds a family-friendly surprise around one moving prop.
summary.ja: 一匹のクモをきっかけに、家族のリアクションを重ねる。

entries.prompt: Set a vertical animated comedy in a warm kitchen. A father waits beside a jar while his daughter and a gray cat watch closely. A second adult enters and spots a very large spider on a chair. Cut to wide eyes, raised hands and the cat freezing, then lower the camera as the spider crawls calmly onto the floor. Give each character a different reaction and time the last beat around a short silence.

title.en: The Tortoise Finishes the Race
title.ja: カメが競走を走り切る

summary.en: A simple animated fable uses different paces to tell the story.
summary.ja: 異なる歩みの速さで伝える短い寓話のアニメ。

entries.prompt: Animate an original retelling of the hare and tortoise. Open wide enough to see the same path and finish marker. Show the hare rushing ahead and later pausing, while the tortoise continues at one steady pace. Alternate their positions until the tortoise crosses the marker, then hold on the surprised reaction.

title.en: A Quiet Beat in an Animated Airplane Cabin
title.ja: アニメの機内で交わす短い表情

summary.en: A cabin two-shot uses one passenger’s expression to turn the scene.
summary.ja: 機内の二人を映し、一人の表情で場面を展開する。

entries.prompt: Animate two adult passengers seated side by side in a quiet airplane cabin. Begin with both in frame, then move to the passenger in oversized glasses as her expression changes. Cut briefly to her companion noticing and back to the shared angle. Keep the light from the window and seat positions consistent and use soft cabin ambience.

title.en: A Slow Swim Through a Tropical Reef
title.ja: 熱帯のサンゴ礁をゆっくり潜る

summary.en: The camera lets coral, fish and clear water establish underwater depth.
summary.ja: サンゴ、魚、澄んだ水で水中の奥行きを見せる。

entries.prompt: Follow a fictional diver moving slowly through clear tropical water. Use a wide view to place the diver among coral, then move level with small fish passing in the foreground. Let light shift across reef surfaces as the camera continues forward. Keep movements slow enough to see through the layers and use a restrained underwater sound bed.

title.en: From a Bootstep to a Desert Canyon
title.ja: 一歩の接写から砂漠の峡谷へ

summary.en: A macro opening turns into a wide canyon reveal without losing direction.
summary.ja: 一歩の接写から、動く向きを保ったまま峡谷の広い画角へ開く。

entries.prompt: Begin tight on a boot pressing onto cracked red stone. Let the surface texture fill the frame for a beat. Tilt upward and move back into a wider track until the boot, the traveler and the canyon are all understood at different scales. Preserve the travel direction as the camera opens to the horizon.

title.en: A Bird Interrupts an Ice Cream Date
title.ja: アイスクリームのデートに鳥が割り込む

summary.en: An accidental drop gives a watercolor strolling scene its comic turn.
summary.ja: 水彩画風の散歩を、アイスの落下でコメディに転じる。

entries.prompt: Paint a sunny 2D walk for a couple sharing an ice cream stop. Hold a medium view as a small bird passes close to a cone. Cut in as the strawberry scoop drops and then back to the couple’s startled looks. Allow a short pause before both laugh. Carry the same colors and street sounds through the cuts.

title.en: Four Cats and a Tiger Share a Dance
title.ja: 四匹の猫とトラが一緒に踊る

summary.en: A wide shot makes the absurd shared animal choreography readable.
summary.ja: 広い画角で動物たちがそろって踊るおかしさを見せる。

entries.prompt: Stage a fictional dance with four distinct cats and one larger tiger. Open wide so every animal stays visible as they begin the same simple motion. Cut once to the difference in size and fur, then return to the group for a beat they all land together. Keep the background and each coat pattern consistent.

title.en: From a Seoul Sidewalk into the Sky
title.ja: ソウルの歩道から空へ

summary.en: A ground-level setup gives way to a flowing citywide aerial view.
summary.ja: 歩道の画角から街を見渡す空撮へつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Open behind an adult on a Seoul sidewalk with the evening light low. Use a continuous-looking change in viewpoint from street height to above the buildings. Pass signs and windows before pulling back to a broad view of the city. Keep the rise smooth, and let the street sounds become quieter as the camera gains distance.

title.en: A Train Through an Undersea Tunnel
title.ja: 透明な海中トンネルを走る列車

summary.en: A platform scene opens out into whales, a glass tunnel and a wide view from above the sea.
summary.ja: 駅のホームから海中トンネルとクジラを見せ、海全体の俯瞰へ移る。

entries.prompt: 青い夜明けの駅に銀色の列車がゆっくり入る。ホームを歩く乗客を横から追い、乗車と窓側の席に腰かける動きを短いカットでつなぐ。列車が透明な海中トンネルに入ったら、窓の外のクラゲとクジラを見せる。車外の俯瞰に切り替え、トンネルが海を横切るところまで引く。最後は車内の横顔に戻り、揺れる水の光を頬に映す。台詞は入れず、静かな水音と列車の走行音を残す。

title.en: Clay Becomes a Miniature Sailing Ship
title.ja: 粘土が小さな帆船に変わる

summary.en: Stop-motion increments show a clay hull, miniature rigging and a finished tabletop ocean.
summary.ja: 粘土の船体から帆やロープ、卓上の海までをコマ撮りで見せる。

entries.prompt: Open overhead on brown clay and sculpting tools on a blue mat. Let the clay take shape in short stop-motion steps: first a hull, then a mast, folds in the sail and fine lines for the rigging. Shift to a lower macro angle as the finished ship moves into a tiny beach and ocean set. Keep each new piece visible just before the next one appears. Finish with a steady close-up of the little vessel on the waves.

title.en: A Magic Sword Flight Above the Cloud Peaks
title.ja: 雲の峰を越える魔法の剣の飛行

summary.en: A flying platform and fabric motion give scale to a cloudscape.
summary.ja: 空飛ぶ足場と衣の動きで雲の世界の大きさを見せる。

entries.prompt: Place a fictional traveler in flowing blue robes on a cliff above a sea of clouds. Show a giant enchanted blade gliding up as a flying platform, then follow the traveler above the peaks. Cut between a wide shot showing the flight path and a close view of the cloth in the wind. Use moving cloud layers for depth.

title.en: A Morning Walk from a Japanese Farmhouse
title.ja: 日本の古民家から朝の散歩へ

summary.en: A wooden doorway and a small woven bag carry a rural morning scene.
summary.ja: 木の戸口と小さなかごでつなぐ田舎の朝。

entries.prompt: Open on a person stepping out of a traditional wooden farmhouse in rural Japan. Hold the doorway and woven shoulder bag in natural morning light. Cut to an unhurried walk past low houses and small details along the route. Keep the clothing and bag consistent. Let birds and footsteps establish the quiet of the village.

title.en: Washing Greens in a Country Kitchen
title.ja: 田舎の台所で青菜を洗う

summary.en: The animated sequence follows water, hands and fresh vegetables.
summary.ja: 水と手元、青菜を追う短い台所のアニメ。

entries.prompt: Animate a morning in a rustic kitchen with soft light falling on a stone sink. A person in an apron rinses green vegetables. Cut close to water moving over the leaves and fingers placing them onto a simple plate. Keep the direction of the light and the positions of the cookware steady between shots.

title.en: Rain, Bookshops and a Warm Café
title.ja: 雨の書店通りと暖かなカフェ

summary.en: A handheld walk uses changing ambience to move from wet streets to indoors.
summary.ja: 手持ちの散歩映像を、雨音と室内音の変化でつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Shoot a fictional rainy-day diary from a handheld point of view. Start at a window looking onto an old street, then follow damp stones past bookstore windows. Move indoors to a cup of coffee and a moment of quiet before stepping out again. Keep pavement reflections and rain audible and avoid sharp lighting shifts at the doorway.

title.en: Everyday Objects Hide Other Worlds
title.ja: 街の物の中に隠れた別世界

summary.en: Street details change in place while the handheld camera keeps the surrounding frame continuous.
summary.ja: 手持ちの画角を保ったまま、街の小物だけが変わっていく。

entries.prompt: Record a fictional handheld walk down a city street. A hand touches a leaf and it reveals a miniature green forest. At the next stop, let a drain become a window onto a ray underwater. Keep the same position and perspective of each object through its change, and leave the sidewalk unchanged. Finish as a round cover reveals a field of stars and the camera recoils. Use natural street sound and a slight focus correction after each reveal.

title.en: An FPV Pass Through a Mid-Autumn Lantern Market
title.ja: 中秋の灯籠市を抜けるFPV

summary.en: One camera path connects lanterns, fabric and a river crossing.
summary.ja: 灯籠、袖の布、水面を一つのカメラの軌跡でつなぐ。

entries.prompt: 拍一段架空的唐代中秋夜航拍。从屋顶俯冲进入花灯街，先掠过近处的灯穗，再在舞者衣袖旁减速，让观众看清灯光与布料。摄影机继续向下贴近水面，跟着小船穿过桥洞，最后平滑升起，回望同一片灯市并停留半拍。全程使用连贯的机位运动，保持街巷与河道位置一致，只保留市集声、风声与水声。

title.en: A Pixel-Art Walk Through a Moonlit Palace
title.ja: 月明かりの宮殿を進むドット絵

summary.en: A locked side view builds depth from windows, curtains and parallax.
summary.ja: 横からの画角を保ち、窓やカーテンの視差で奥行きを作る。

entries.prompt: 月明かりが差し込む暗い宮殿を舞台に、架空のキャラクターが画面左から右へ進むドット絵の動画を作る。カメラは真横に置き、階段を上がる動きに合わせてゆっくり追従する。手前の大理石の床を速く、奥の窓とカーテンをゆっくり流して奥行きを出す。途中で視点を切り替えず、足音と短い電子音で動きの節目を示す。キャラクターの衣装と配色は全編で統一する。

title.en: Glossy Korean-Style Chicken in Close-Up
title.ja: 韓国風チキンの照りを接写する

summary.en: A warm food sequence moves from overhead preparation to the finished glaze.
summary.ja: 暖かい台所の俯瞰から仕上げの照りへ近づく。

entries.prompt: Film a warm kitchen sequence of a glazed chicken dish. Start above the cutting board, then move to a bowl and fast insert shots of the coating. Cut close after cooking as a glossy glaze coats the pieces. End on a plated serving and preserve the same warm room light and texture.

title.en: A Wedding Transformation on the Run
title.ja: 走りながら婚礼衣装に変わる二人

summary.en: A matching camera move keeps a couple’s wardrobe transformation legible through a location cut.
summary.ja: カメラの動きをそろえ、衣装の変化と場所の切り替えを見せる。

entries.prompt: Follow a fictional couple running down an empty corridor. When one stumbles, the other slows to help and they take off together. Keep the follow shot moving as their everyday clothing becomes formal wedding attire in a single brief transition. Match their pace into a grand stairway and pull back to show the long fabric train following behind. Keep the actors' positions and direction consistent and leave the scene quiet.

title.en: A Glowing Pumpkin Shop in the Fog
title.ja: 霧に浮かぶカボチャの店

summary.en: A foggy street and warm display lights lead into a Halloween shop.
summary.ja: 霧の街から暖かな陳列の光に導かれるハロウィーンの店。

entries.prompt: Follow a fictional visitor down a foggy street on Halloween night. Let the light from a small shop separate from the mist before she notices it. Move from silhouettes outside to a close view of glowing pumpkins in the window. End just inside the doorway and preserve the cool fog and warm light on either side.

title.en: A Passing Tram on the Busan Coast
title.ja: 釜山の海辺を通る路面電車

summary.en: A passing tram gives a seafront portrait one clear movement behind the subject.
summary.ja: 海辺の人物の背後を路面電車が横切る。

entries.prompt: Frame a short portrait on a sloping coastal street in Busan. Let the person point toward the sea, then hold her on the sidewalk as a bright tram passes behind. Approach for a small smile and a hand reaching toward the camera. Finish on the blue water with the passing street sound fading.

title.en: Restoring a Tiny Vintage Car
title.ja: 小さなクラシックカーの修復

summary.en: Time-lapse steps show a miniature car changing from worn to finished.
summary.ja: ミニチュアの車が古びた状態から完成するまでを早回しで見せる。

entries.prompt: Use one miniature workshop and a weathered vintage car. Keep the camera close and the vehicle centered while tiny workers remove old pieces, reveal cleaner surfaces and finish the paint. Change the angle only when it helps show a new stage. End with the restored car in the same workshop for a direct visual comparison.

title.en: Turquoise Fabric and Gold in Motion
title.ja: 動くターコイズの布と金の装飾

summary.en: A dance portrait alternates full movement and fabric details.
summary.ja: 踊りの全身と布の細部を交互に映すポートレート。

entries.prompt: Create a vertical dance portrait around a turquoise satin costume with gold trim. Start close on the movement of a braid and jewelry, then pull back so the whole dance is visible. Make the veil continue moving after a turn and hold the silhouette as it settles. Use the same soft light throughout.

title.en: Rack Focus from Eyeliner to Shadow
title.ja: アイラインから壁の影へのピント送り

summary.en: One focus shift trades a near portrait detail for the background silhouette.
summary.ja: 一度のピント移動で手前の目元から背景の影に視線を移す。

entries.prompt: Light a close portrait with a hard source that casts an elongated shadow on the back wall. Start with focus on the near eye and hair curl. Keep the camera fixed as focus moves decisively toward the shadow and a figure beside it. Hold the new plane briefly while the foreground falls out of focus.

title.en: An Awkward Morning Bowl of Noodles
title.ja: 朝のラーメンをめぐる気まずい場面

summary.en: A quiet meal sets up a few reaction cuts and a warmer ending.
summary.ja: 静かな食事をきっかけに、リアクションを重ねて穏やかに締める。

entries.prompt: In a quiet bedroom lit by morning sun, show an adult eating noodles carefully while a second adult sleeps nearby. Cut to the sleeper waking and noticing the bowl, then the eater pausing in mid-bite. Play their exchange with short, awkward looks. End in a wider shot as the tension gives way to shared amusement.

title.en: A Red Umbrella Through a Painted City
title.ja: 手描きの街を進む赤い傘

summary.en: One red umbrella holds the eye through fog and muted shopfronts.
summary.ja: 霧と渋い色の店先の中で赤い傘に視線を集める。

entries.prompt: Paint a foggy New York morning with warm gray streets and one bright red umbrella. Follow the umbrella from a wider street view past amber shop windows. Move closer when it turns a corner and let watercolor edges soften the distant buildings. Keep the umbrella the strongest color, with subtle footstep and street sounds.

title.en: The Last Train on a Rainy Tokyo Night
title.ja: 雨の東京、終電へ

summary.en: Three walking angles lead from wet neon streets to a quiet station entrance.
summary.ja: 雨のネオン街から静かな駅入口までを三つの画角で歩く。

entries.prompt: Follow an adult in a dark coat and clear umbrella along a wet Tokyo street late at night. First track from behind, then cut to a medium view through the drops on the umbrella. Move low for footsteps and reflections before showing her reach a nearly empty station entrance. Pull back as rain and station sounds meet.

title.en: Walking into a Sunflower Café
title.ja: ヒマワリのカフェに入る

summary.en: A café entrance carries warm light and sunflower shapes from the opening image into motion.
summary.ja: 開始画像のヒマワリと暖かな光を保って、カフェの入り口を動画にする。

entries.prompt: Begin with your own image of an adult entering a concrete-walled café filled with sunflowers. Set the camera at fixed positions. Match the person's steps from a doorway shot to a low view of the flower table, then to a still close-up of her holding a cup. Let the pendant light take over from the daylight outside and keep the room and wardrobe in the same positions across cuts. Use quiet footsteps and room ambience.

title.en: A Paper Town Under a Folded Moon
title.ja: 折り紙の月の下の紙の街

summary.en: Macro views reveal small changes in a handmade landscape.
summary.ja: 手作りの風景の小さな変化をマクロで見せる。

entries.prompt: Place a handmade paper town on a worktable. Start close to the folded edges and pull high enough to reveal a paper moon rising behind it. Let small elements of the town change one at a time as the light moves across the folds. Keep the materials visibly paper and finish on the complete scene.

title.en: Tiny Bakers in a Croissant Landscape
title.ja: クロワッサンの世界の小さなパン職人

summary.en: Tilt-shift depth makes a pastry landscape read as a miniature world.
summary.ja: 浅いピントでパンの風景をミニチュアの世界に見せる。

entries.prompt: Open above a miniature landscape made of croissants and pastry. Lower the camera among tiny bakers working beside a giant flaky ridge. Cut closer to crumbs and layers breaking in warm light, then pull back to restore the scale. Use a tactile stop-motion feel and keep the frame focused on the workers.

title.en: A Dropped Chocolate Bar in the Candy Aisle
title.ja: お菓子売り場に落ちたチョコレート

summary.en: A small fall and a sibling’s reaction carry a brief store comedy.
summary.ja: 小さな転倒ときょうだいの反応で見せる売り場のコメディ。

entries.prompt: Set a short 3D comedy in a colorful candy aisle. A toddler reaches toward a chocolate bar and loses balance as her older sister bends to help. Cut close to the bar landing on the floor, then back to the toddler’s startled reaction. Show her sister taking her hand before they leave together. Keep the motion gentle.

title.en: A Motorcycle and a Panther on the Coast
title.ja: 海岸道路のバイクと黒いヒョウ

summary.en: Tracking shots and a moment of stillness interrupt a winding-road sequence.
summary.ja: 曲がりくねった道の追走カットに、静止した一瞬を差し込む。

entries.prompt: Track behind a fictional rider on a coastal mountain road under soft clouds. Cut to a side angle that holds the cliff and ocean in the background. The rider stops at a safe pullout and notices a black panther near the roadside. Cut between the still animal and the rider's quiet reaction. Return to a wide follow shot as the bike moves away, leaving the animal where it was. Keep the same jacket and motorcycle throughout.

title.en: A Paris Fashion Walk from One Photo
title.ja: 一枚の画像からパリのファッション散歩

summary.en: A starting image leads into matching street portraits and full-length shots.
summary.ja: 開始画像から、街での寄りと全身のカットへつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Begin with your own image of a fictional model in a beige coat. Continue the walk along a Paris street with a steady side track, then take a closer angle for fabric and hair moving in the breeze. Return to a full-length silhouette. Keep the same clothes, pace and color palette across the walk.

title.en: An Empty Cockpit in a Fictional Film
title.ja: 無人の操縦室を描く架空の映画

summary.en: Close handheld framing, empty seats and an exterior cut create suspense.
summary.ja: 手持ちの寄り、空席、機外のカットで緊張を作る。

entries.prompt: Open in a fictional aircraft cockpit as a character notices the empty seats. Hold tight on the reaction and the illuminated instruments while the frame shakes slightly. Cut to an exterior shot of the aircraft in turbulent clouds. Build the sequence around alarm tone, cabin movement and the character’s expression.

title.en: A Skincare Jar Revealed Through Water
title.ja: 水面から見せるスキンケア容器

summary.en: Ripples, droplets and a final packshot structure a skincare commercial.
summary.ja: 波紋、水滴、最後の商品カットで組み立てたスキンケア広告。

entries.prompt: Stage a silver-lidded moisturizer jar on a reflective blue surface. Move gently forward as ripples pass beneath the jar. Cut to a macro view of water droplets and white petals near the glass, then bring focus back to the jar as the water settles. End centered with an uncluttered packshot in cool soft light. Use the same jar shape and lid in each shot.

title.en: A Rolling Egg on a Mountain Cliff
title.ja: 山の崖を転がる卵

summary.en: A rolling egg gives a stylized scene a simple movement to follow across cuts.
summary.ja: 転がる卵を追い、複数のカットを一つの動きでつなぐ。

entries.prompt: In a stylized 3D mountain scene, show a mother bird moving along a rocky ledge with eggs in a cloth basket. One egg slips loose. Move from the bird's startled reaction to a low view of the egg bouncing along the rock. Keep its path clear in each new angle and show the bird moving to catch up. Use warm late-day light and short taps as the shell contacts the stone.

title.en: A Bunny’s Portrait Under a Blue Sky
title.ja: 青空の下のウサギのポートレート

summary.en: A fixed close frame gives small ear and paw movements space to read.
summary.ja: 固定した寄りで耳や前足の小さな動きを見せる。

entries.prompt: Center a cream-colored animated bunny with a gingham scarf against a bright blue sky. Hold the portrait as its ears twitch, then let it tilt its head and lift its paws in a quiet greeting. Keep the scarf and headband consistent and finish on the small change in expression.

title.en: Hand-Drawn Creatures Wander Into a Real Street
title.ja: 実写の街に入り込む手描きの生き物

summary.en: First-person framing connects animated characters and live-looking surroundings.
summary.ja: 一人称の画角でアニメのキャラクターと実写風の環境をつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Move in first person down an old-fashioned street. Let original ink-drawn creatures bounce between signs while people continue walking normally. Turn into a hall where a tiny drawn server slides along a real counter. Use flat colors and elastic animation for the creatures, and keep the lighting and camera motion coherent in the surroundings.

title.en: A Serum Bottle in a Golden Liquid Swirl
title.ja: 金色の液体から現れる美容液ボトル

summary.en: Curved streams and warm backlight lead to a clear product reveal.
summary.ja: 曲がる液体と暖かな逆光で容器を見せる。

entries.prompt: Open on a white liquid splash backlit in warm amber. Move the camera gradually around droplets and leaves as a single orange-and-white serum pump bottle comes into view. Preserve the bottle’s shape as the swirl settles. End on a centered product with a clean outline against the remaining light.

title.en: A Gloved Hand Changes the Floating Outfit
title.ja: 手袋の手で浮いた服を切り替える

summary.en: One repeated swipe motivates each apparel change in a neutral studio.
summary.ja: 同じスワイプで無地のスタジオの衣装を切り替える。

entries.prompt: Hang a complete outfit in midair in a pastel studio. A black-gloved hand crosses the frame once, and the garment arrangement changes as the hand leaves. Match the heights and camera placement with each new look. Let fabric settle between changes and close on one clearly framed complete outfit.

title.en: Crayons, a Crumpled Drawing and a Hug
title.ja: クレヨンとくしゃくしゃの絵、仲直り

summary.en: The drawing moves between two children and sets up a gentle reconciliation.
summary.ja: 絵をめぐる二人のやりとりから穏やかな仲直りへつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Animate a child drawing with crayons on the living room floor. Let a younger sibling reach for the page and crumple it, then cut between the surprised reaction and the sibling beginning to cry. Hold a wider framing as the older child offers a hug. Keep the camera low and the paper visible through the scene.

title.en: Five Dancers Take the Stage Together
title.ja: 五人のダンサーが一緒にステージへ

summary.en: A dark backstage formation opens into a synchronized wide performance.
summary.ja: 暗い舞台裏の隊形から、そろった踊りの引き画へつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Start with five fictional performers standing in formation backstage. Let silhouettes change as the stage lights brighten, then reveal all five in a wide front view at the musical cue. Cut closer for a brief synchronized movement and return wide before the formation changes. Keep the spacing and stage lighting consistent.

title.en: Three Friends at a Mountain Camp
title.ja: 山のキャンプ場の三人の友人

summary.en: The outdoor diary alternates broad mountain scenery and small campsite tasks.
summary.ja: 山の広い景色とキャンプの小さな作業を交互に映す。

entries.prompt: Film a fictional weekend camp with three friends in the mountains of South Korea. Open on their walk to the site with gear, then cut to hands setting up and small reactions. End on a wider view of the group and the hillside. Keep a casual camcorder look, with tent fabric and wind audible.

title.en: A Pop Concert from Behind the Stage
title.ja: 舞台の背後から始まるポップコンサート

summary.en: Stage lights and crowd scale set the rhythm for a short performance clip.
summary.ja: ステージ照明と客席の規模で短い公演映像のリズムを作る。

entries.prompt: Create a fictional short concert. Open at the side of the stage with the house still dark, then follow one original performer into the key light. Cut between the microphone, the audience in a wide shot and the singer moving across the stage. Keep lighting cues synchronized with the music and crowd response.

title.en: The Hill That Takes a Breath
title.ja: 息をする丘

summary.en: A quiet dawn scene reveals a large creature through one subtle movement.
summary.ja: 静かな夜明けに、小さな動きで大きな生き物の存在を見せる。

entries.prompt: Set a fantasy scene in pine woods and grass at misty dawn. Follow a traveler toward what looks like a still hill. Hold a wide enough view to see the ground rise slightly, then cut close to her realizing the shape is alive. Keep the creature mostly obscured and let wind and vegetation carry the tension.

title.en: The Secret Strawberry Garden
title.ja: イチゴの中の小さな庭

summary.en: A miniature garden inside a strawberry gives a kitchen sequence a series of motivated reveals.
summary.ja: イチゴの中の小さな庭をきっかけに、台所の場面を展開する。

entries.prompt: Start from an original illustrated character in a nighttime kitchen. She opens the fridge and takes out a strawberry. Cut to the blade opening it and then move in to reveal a tiny glowing garden inside. Return to her hands as she prepares a jelly dessert around the miniature world. Close on the finished plate with gentle reflections. Keep the kitchen layout consistent and give each cut a clear sound cue, such as the fridge door or a spoon against glass.

title.en: An Italian Street Suspended in Time
title.ja: 時間が止まったイタリアの街

summary.en: Moving camera and motionless street details make a time-freeze effect readable.
summary.ja: 動くカメラと止まった街の細部で時間停止を見せる。

entries.prompt: Start with your own image of a fictional traveler in a sunlit Italian lane. Follow the traveler while pedestrians, pigeons and loose particles freeze in place around her. Keep their positions fixed as the camera changes angle. Use the continued motion of the traveler and camera to distinguish the effect from a still image.

title.en: The Mechanic Who Moves in Bursts
title.ja: 瞬発的に動く整備士

summary.en: An animated garage repair uses brief pauses and rhythmic tool movement.
summary.ja: 短い静止とリズムのある工具の動きで描くガレージのアニメ。

entries.prompt: Animate a mechanic facing a rattling old car in a dim garage. Let the mechanic pause, make one quick exaggerated movement with a tool and settle again before the next beat. Use short close-ups on changing vehicle parts and a wide angle on the workbench. Finish with the car sitting steady under the same garage light.

title.en: A Morning Flip-Camera Diary in Indonesia
title.ja: インドネシアの村の小型カメラ日記

summary.en: A home-video treatment follows a village house, fruit trees and a courtyard.
summary.ja: 家庭用カメラ風に、村の家、果樹、中庭をたどる。

entries.prompt: Start from an original image of a fictional adult outside a wooden village house in Indonesia. Walk past banana and papaya plants, then turn the camera toward a basket of vegetables in the courtyard. Let framing be slightly off-center and focus settle naturally. Keep warm, faded colors and the everyday sounds of the garden.

title.en: A Dinosaur Beyond a Fallen Log
title.ja: 倒木の向こうの恐竜

summary.en: The low frame holds the wet jungle floor and the scale of a nearby fictional dinosaur.
summary.ja: 低い画角で湿った地面と架空の恐竜の大きさを見せる。

entries.prompt: Open at ground level in a wet jungle with a mossy log filling part of the frame. Show a fictional explorer holding still as a large dinosaur’s head appears beyond the log. Let focus shift from droplets to the creature and back to the explorer’s reaction. Keep the movement restrained and the silence between breaths audible.

title.en: A Pumpkin Cup Draws a Crowd
title.ja: カボチャのカップに集まるモンスター

summary.en: A playful Halloween product ad makes one prop the center of three fast beats.
summary.ja: 一つの小道具を中心に展開するハロウィーンの広告。

entries.prompt: Use an original starting image of a person reaching for a pumpkin-shaped cup in a shop. The light dims and a group of costumed monsters rush toward the prop. Follow the person into the street, cut to a position low enough to keep the cup visible and make it the focus of a harmless comic scramble. End on a clear close-up with the cup in the foreground. Keep its shape and orange color consistent.

title.en: A Golden Dragon Through the Waterfall
title.ja: 滝を越える金色の龍

summary.en: A moving waterfall and cloud gap mark the flight path of a fantasy creature.
summary.ja: 滝と雲の切れ目で架空の飛行の進路を見せる。

entries.prompt: Follow a golden dragon with a red mane as it passes beside a large waterfall. Begin from a side angle and let water spray cross the foreground. Reveal a rider and a broad floating landscape as the camera moves through a cloud gap. Keep the flight direction continuous and change the light gradually as the landscape opens.

title.en: A Penguin on a Striped Rug
title.ja: しま模様のじゅうたんに立つペンギン

summary.en: A steady push-in gives a young penguin’s change in expression a clear beat.
summary.ja: 寄りの動きでペンギンの表情が変わる瞬間を見せる。

entries.prompt: Animate a small penguin with a pink bow on a striped rug. Start wide enough to show its size, then push in slowly as it looks around and smiles. Let the expression shift to quiet determination, with a tiny dip of the body and lift of its wings. Use soft light and keep the rug fixed.

title.en: A White Kitten Offers a Bouquet
title.ja: 花束を差し出す白い子猫

summary.en: The bouquet and pink room frame small paw and ear movements.
summary.ja: ピンクの部屋と花束の中で前足や耳が少し動く。

entries.prompt: Place a fluffy white animated kitten in a pastel bedroom with a small bouquet. Keep it centered while one ear moves and the front paws bring the flowers nearer to camera. Let the background flowers stay soft so the bouquet and expression stand out. End on a slight tilt of the head.

title.en: A Side-Scrolling Toy Town in the Sky
title.ja: 空に浮かぶおもちゃの町の横スクロール

summary.en: Foreground bridges and distant toy towers move at different speeds.
summary.ja: 手前の橋と遠くのおもちゃの塔を異なる速度で流す。

entries.prompt: 淡い青空に浮かぶおもちゃの町を、架空のドット絵の主人公が左から右へ進む。動く足場と太い橋を手前に置き、遠くの塔とピンク色の滝はゆっくり流す。ジャンプでは真横のカメラが少し上下し、着地したら元の高さに戻る。通り道の奥行きと足場の位置を保ち、ゴール近くでだけ軽く寄る。灰色の台紙や参考画像の文字は画面に入れない。

title.en: A Pink River in a Fruit Garden
title.ja: 果物の庭を流れるピンク色の川

summary.en: A bright fantasy landscape uses oversized fruit to establish a vivid sense of scale.
summary.ja: 巨大な果物と川の色で、空想の庭のスケールを見せる。

entries.prompt: Glide over a pink river in a bright 3D garden where strawberries and grapes are the size of trees. Open wide, then descend between the fruit to catch reflections and ripples at river level. Keep the giant fruit rooted in the same positions as the camera goes by. Use warm midday light, clean silhouettes and soft splashes to connect the wide and close views.

title.en: A Transparent Smart Kitchen Appliance
title.ja: 透明な庫内のスマート調理器

summary.en: The chamber and a golden food reveal give a futuristic appliance demo its structure.
summary.ja: 透明な庫内と黄金色の料理を順に見せる未来の調理器のデモ。

entries.prompt: Set an unbranded white appliance with a transparent chamber on a clean kitchen counter. Open with the door moving aside and cool light inside. Cut across a preparation shot and a close view of a finished golden snack. Finish on the machine and plated result in the same natural room light.

title.en: A Baby Copies Grandma in the Kitchen
title.ja: 台所でおばあちゃんをまねる赤ちゃん

summary.en: Two matching poses create the comic beat in a family kitchen.
summary.ja: 家族の台所で、二人が同じポーズを取るところを笑いに使う。

entries.prompt: In a warm animated kitchen, have a grandmother set a dish down and place her hands on her lower back. Cut to a watching baby carefully copying the same pose with exaggerated seriousness. Return to the grandmother noticing him, then let the two expressions land in a single wider shot.

title.en: A Delivery Robot in an Everyday China Vlog
title.ja: 中国の日常Vlogに映る配達ロボット

summary.en: Street and store details give a fictional smartphone diary something concrete to observe.
summary.ja: 街と店の細部を観察する架空のスマートフォンVlog。

entries.prompt: Create a fictional travel diary on an ordinary city sidewalk in China. Let a small delivery robot pass while other people continue walking. Follow it briefly with the phone, then cut to a convenience store and an unfamiliar snack on the shelf. Keep the camera casual and let the city sounds set the pace.

title.en: Clouds, a Ring and Mechanical Wings
title.ja: 雲とリング、機械の翼

summary.en: A turquoise ring cues successive equipment reveals against one cloudscape.
summary.ja: 空の色を保ちながら、ターコイズのリングを合図に装備が現れる。

entries.prompt: Suspend an original fictional character over a cloud layer. Start close on a turquoise ring lighting up, then show mechanical boots and gauntlets forming in separate readable steps. Keep the same costume colors and direction of light. Pull back as the mechanical wings unfold and hold long enough to see their complete shape.

title.en: A Picnic Table Becomes a Giant Landscape
title.ja: ピクニックテーブルが巨大な世界に

summary.en: Ordinary food and a bee make the scale change easy to read.
summary.ja: 食べ物とハチを基準にして大きさの変化を見せる。

entries.prompt: Set a surreal scene in a sunny park. Follow a fictional adult toward a picnic table before cutting to tabletop height as she becomes tiny. Use sandwiches, a drink and a passing bee as scale references. Track between the objects and keep the layout stable while the person moves through them.

title.en: An Ink-Wash Journey from Waves to Blossoms
title.ja: 波から桜へ移る水墨画の旅

summary.en: Ink spreading across the paper becomes the transition between landscapes.
summary.ja: 紙に広がる墨を風景の切り替わりに使う。

entries.prompt: Begin with deep blue waves painted on paper. Let the wet pigment spread into mist around mountain ridges and a low pagoda. Use a thin sweep of red ink to shift into a calm river with a small boat. Finish as the red shade becomes pale blossoms, keeping the texture of the same paper visible throughout.

title.en: A Father and Baby Trade Funny Faces
title.ja: 父と赤ちゃんの変顔合戦

summary.en: Alternating close-ups make a small living-room performance feel like a conversation.
summary.ja: 交互の接写で父と赤ちゃんの表情を会話のように見せる。

entries.prompt: Create a vertical 3D comedy in a sunny living room. Begin with a father holding his daughter and her teddy bear. Move from the two-shot to the baby in close-up as she scrunches her face around her pacifier. Hold one beat, then show her father copying the expression with theatrical seriousness. Alternate their reactions and end with both in the same frame. Keep the bear and position of the characters consistent.

title.en: From an Espresso Pour to the Café Table
title.ja: エスプレッソからカフェのテーブルへ

summary.en: Coffee preparation and everyday customer scenes share one cup color.
summary.ja: 抽出と日常のカフェ風景を同じカップの色でつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Open on beans being ground, then move close to espresso filling a red-and-yellow unbranded cup. Cut to steamed milk and a simple finish on the surface. Match the cup’s color and shape into a few ordinary café or street scenes. End on a clean tabletop view with the preparation sounds fading.

title.en: A Sleepy Lizard and a Chili Plant
title.ja: 眠そうなトカゲと唐辛子の苗

summary.en: A sandy riverbank gives a tiny cartoon creature and plant a clear scale.
summary.ja: 川辺の砂地で小さなトカゲと苗の大きさを見せる。

entries.prompt: Animate a small green creature sitting beside a chili plant on a sunny riverbank. Start at sand level and hold the two in frame while the creature notices the pepper. Cut to a slow blink and a small hand movement. Keep the background water and leaves moving gently and finish with the little plant still the scale reference.

title.en: A Handheld Demo for a Fictional Camera App
title.ja: 架空のカメラアプリを手持ちで紹介

summary.en: Phone framing and screen inserts structure a creator-style product demo.
summary.ja: スマートフォンの画角と画面の差し込みで商品紹介を組み立てる。

entries.prompt: Film a fictional smartphone demo for an imaginary camera app. Start with an original creator showing a simple capture. Cut to a readable screen insert and then to the result in the same room. Use a natural handheld camera and keep the interface consistent across the cuts. End with a clear product shot.

title.en: The Sky Bakery That Bakes the Sunrise
title.ja: 朝日を焼く空のパン屋

summary.en: A cloud kingdom and enormous ovens establish an animated adventure.
summary.ja: 雲の王国と巨大なオーブンを舞台にしたアニメの冒険。

entries.prompt: Open on a floating bakery where huge ovens glow above the clouds. Follow a baker’s apprentice and a small ash dragon from a flour-covered work surface onto a rope bridge. Cut between close baking details and the cloud kingdom. Let the ovens brighten across the sequence until the last shot fills with dawn light.

title.en: A Bench in a Busy Street Market
title.ja: にぎやかな市場にある木のベンチ

summary.en: A static street prop becomes the focus of a quick comic reversal.
summary.ja: 街の何気ない小道具を使った短いコメディの逆転。

entries.prompt: Open in a fictional Indian market with a motorcycle easing to a stop at the side. Follow one rider stepping off and calmly lifting a wooden bench in an exaggerated comic gesture. Cut to the other rider’s surprise before returning to an ordinary wide shot of the market. Keep background movement steady and let the pause carry the joke.

title.en: A Family Reunion Outside School
title.ja: 学校の前で家族と再会

summary.en: A small backpack and a family two-shot anchor a warm animated reunion.
summary.ja: 小さなランドセルと家族の画角で再会を描くアニメ。

entries.prompt: Animate a boy with a red backpack looking for his family outside school. Follow him at walking height and pause as he sees his mother holding a younger child. Cut to two brief expressions, then hold a wider shot as the family comes together. Keep the sunny light and character designs consistent.

title.en: Two Chicks Argue on a Garden Path
title.ja: 庭の小道で言い合う二羽のひよこ

summary.en: Contrasting poses make a small animated disagreement readable.
summary.ja: 異なるポーズで小さなアニメの言い合いを伝える。

entries.prompt: Place two animated yellow chicks on a quiet garden path. Let the smaller chick fold its wings and turn away while the taller chick leans closer. Hold both in frame briefly, then cut to each expression and back to their shared position. Keep the movements small and the sunlight warm.

title.en: Inside a Miniature Chocolate Factory
title.ja: ミニチュアのチョコレート工場

summary.en: Tiny workers and conveyors show an illustrated chocolate production sequence.
summary.ja: 小さな作業員とコンベヤーでチョコレートの工程を見せる。

entries.prompt: Film an imaginary chocolate factory in miniature. Move at conveyor height past cocoa beans, then cut between mixing, filling molds and rows of cooling bars. Let the workers and tools provide a consistent scale reference. End on finished pieces moving down the belt, with warm practical light and machine sounds.

title.en: A Milkshake at a 1950s Diner
title.ja: 1950年代のダイナーのミルクシェイク

summary.en: Chrome, red vinyl and window light frame a quiet period moment.
summary.ja: クローム、赤いビニール、窓の光で時代の一場面を作る。

entries.prompt: Create a fictional 1950s diner scene with chrome stools and a checkerboard floor. Hold a medium view of a customer at the counter with a tall milkshake. Cut closer to the glass and her small reaction as the light catches the chrome. Return wide enough for neon and red seats to establish the setting.

title.en: A Tiny Mushroom on a Tabletop
title.ja: テーブルの上の小さなキノコ

summary.en: A tabletop macro scene uses a hand and a drop of water to establish the character’s scale.
summary.ja: 手と水滴を比較対象に、テーブル上のキャラクターの小ささを見せる。

entries.prompt: Place a palm-sized furry creature with a spotted red mushroom cap on a wooden table. At macro distance, show it notice a bead of water and dab its eyes with a scrap of tissue. It then runs across the wood grain past a resting hand that makes its size clear. Track alongside at tabletop height. Keep the room softly out of focus and emphasize light footsteps and the texture of the tabletop.

title.en: Watching a Singer from the Upstairs Railing
title.ja: 二階の手すりから見るステージ

summary.en: Three angles connect a balcony reaction to a small performance below.
summary.ja: 二階の反応と下の小さなステージを三つの画角でつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Set a short story in a two-level bar. Start on a patron chatting by the upstairs railing, then hold as he turns toward a sound. Cut down to a singer on the small stage and let practical lights mark the eyeline. End on a shared view that makes the relationship between balcony and stage clear.

title.en: A Tiger Cub at Daybreak
title.ja: 夜明けのトラの子

summary.en: Low wildlife coverage and a dawn ridge reveal follow a cub exploring at its own pace.
summary.ja: 低い視点と夜明けの尾根の引き画で、子トラの探索を追う。

entries.prompt: Open low on a tiger cub in tall grass beside its mother at dawn. Follow it climbing over a root and pausing to bat at a falling leaf. Cut closer to the ears turning when it hears a sound, then show the mother waiting nearby. Transition from the intimate low angles to a wide view of both tigers on a forest ridge. Keep coat markings consistent and let birds, water and moving grass fill the soundtrack.

title.en: An Otter Meets a Goose
title.ja: カワウソとガチョウの出会い

summary.en: A small exchange by a clear lake uses cutaways, eye lines and reactions instead of spoken dialogue.
summary.ja: 澄んだ湖のほとりで、視線とリアクションを使って見せる小さな交流。

entries.prompt: At the edge of a clear mountain lake, show a young otter sit up with a small fish. Frame its approach toward a white goose at water level, with the grass and reeds tracking steadily behind them. Cut between the otter showing its catch and the goose leaning in. Finish on both animals in one wide shot. Keep their natural scale, let the water ripple and use gentle animal and lakeside sounds.

title.en: A Silhouette Becomes Lightning
title.ja: シルエットが稲妻になる

summary.en: Rain and a fixed direction of motion carry a fantasy VFX transformation.
summary.ja: 雨と一定の進行方向でファンタジーの変化をつなぐ。

entries.prompt: In heavy rain, introduce a fictional runner in dark clothes. Let a thin glow gather around the silhouette and spread into a trail as he moves. Momentarily reduce him to streaks of light and reform the same shape farther along the path. Keep the camera direction and rain consistent across the effect.

title.en: Snowboard POV into an Ice Portal
title.ja: 氷のポータルへ滑るスノーボード視点

summary.en: A fictional descent changes environments while maintaining the direction of travel.
summary.ja: 架空の滑走で、進行方向を保ったまま周囲の景色を変える。

entries.prompt: Make a fantastical snowboard POV over a snowy slope at sunset. Keep a clear forward path as the snow and dark rocks pass on either side. Enter a purple-blue portal with light streaming in the same direction, then emerge above a mirrorlike ice lake. Preserve camera speed and let the sound soften on the ice.

title.en: A Mummy Costume on the Sidewalk
title.ja: 歩道でミイラの衣装に変わる

summary.en: One unbroken backward track gives a costume change its comic timing.
summary.ja: 後ろ向きのワンカットで衣装変化の間を作る。

entries.prompt: Track backward on a modern sidewalk as a fictional performer walks toward the camera. Hold full-body framing when the outfit changes into frayed linen bands with small gold details. Let the subject take two awkward runway steps before settling into a very deliberate pose. Keep the shot continuous and the background ordinary.

title.en: A Horse Takes on the Shape of a Storm
title.ja: 嵐の姿になる馬

summary.en: Transform the mane, the hooves and then the silhouette in separate readable beats.
summary.ja: たてがみ、ひづめ、全体の輪郭を順に変える。

entries.prompt: Show a dark stallion in a windy fantasy landscape. Change the mane into bright flowing arcs first, then add swirling air around its hooves. Move wider as the body becomes a partly translucent storm silhouette and keeps moving forward. Preserve the underlying horse motion and use wind and distant thunder for the progression.

title.en: Motocross in the Rain
title.ja: 雨のモトクロス

summary.en: Rain on a visor opens into low shots of a muddy racecourse.
summary.ja: バイザーの雨粒から泥のコースを低い角度で映す。

entries.prompt: Open close on rain gathering on a motocross helmet. Cut to a wider view as riders enter a designated muddy course. Track at a low angle to show the spray and ruts, then hold a broader shot so the race direction stays readable. Keep the overcast light consistent and use the rain and engines to set the pace.

title.en: A Red Scarf Winds Through Paris
title.ja: 赤いマフラーがパリを駆ける

summary.en: The motion of one bright scarf ties together animated views of Paris.
summary.ja: 一本の赤いマフラーの動きでパリの風景をつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Animate a woman in a dark coat walking through Paris with an impossibly long red scarf. Start close enough to see it lift in the wind, then follow its path past a market, around a bench and across the frame as the street opens toward the river. Keep the character's walk steady and use the scarf as the main moving line. Use hand-drawn shapes, a restrained palette and a little wind and street sound.

title.en: A Rover Meets a Desert Superstorm
title.ja: 砂漠の嵐に立ち向かう探査車

summary.en: A wide storm reveal gives way to a vehicle close-up and one last exterior shot.
summary.ja: 嵐の広い画角から車内の接写を挟み、最後に車外へ切り替える。

entries.prompt: Stage a short science-fiction sequence in a desaturated desert. Begin from far above as the leading edge of a storm swallows the horizon behind a rover. Jump in close for dashboard reflections and shaking dust, then cut outside as the vehicle crests a dune. Hold the silhouette against flashes inside the storm cloud. End abruptly on black with a single deep sound and preserve the rover’s direction across the cuts.

title.en: An Alternate-History Sunrise over Rome
title.ja: 架空の現代ローマの日の出

summary.en: Ancient masonry and a modern skyline share one imagined city reveal.
summary.ja: 古い石造建築と現代の高層ビルを同じ架空の都市で見せる。
