entries.prompt: Imagine a clearly fictional modern Rome where ancient monuments remain central to the city. Start with a sunrise aerial over the old arena and aqueducts. Glide past stone façades into a wider skyline with newer towers behind them. Keep the two architectural periods visible in the same light rather than treating them as separate locations.

title.en: A Dance Rehearsal in a Mirror Studio
title.ja: 鏡のあるスタジオでダンス練習

summary.en: A casual rehearsal vlog sets the phone down so the audience can see the whole movement.
summary.ja: スマートフォンを置いた画角で、練習中の全身の動きを見せる。

entries.prompt: Begin from the front-facing camera in a dance studio. A dancer briefly checks the frame, then sets the phone down so the group and mirror are visible. Hold as the group rehearses a short combination with clear footwork and matching reflections. Pick the camera up for a moment of breath and a smile, then pan back toward the group repeating the sequence. Keep the same room and outfits and use the sound of shoes and music from the room.

title.en: A Hand-Drawn Carbonara Sequence
title.ja: 手描きで作るカルボナーラ

summary.en: Warm food textures and a few precise movements make the dish readable.
summary.ja: 暖かい食材の質感と短い手の動きで料理を見せる。

entries.prompt: Animate a short carbonara preparation with original hand-drawn backgrounds. Open on the counter, then cut close to pasta lifting from water and ingredients mixing in a warm pan. Hold the last plate long enough for steam and surface texture to read. Use soft natural colors and simple kitchen sounds.

title.en: A Village Bakery Before Opening
title.ja: 開店前の村のパン屋

summary.en: Dawn light and changes in dough texture shape a small baking story.
summary.ja: 朝の光と生地の質感の変化で小さなパン作りを描く。

entries.prompt: Draw an original village bakery at dawn with the windows still dim. Move from hands shaping dough to flour hanging in the early light, then show the first loaves leaving the oven. Keep a consistent layout so the sequence reads as one place waking up. Finish on the bread cooling near the window.

title.en: A Race-Day Portrait in 1920s England
title.ja: 1920年代の英国競馬場のポートレート

summary.en: A period outfit and the distant track share a short sporting vignette.
summary.ja: 時代の衣装と遠くのコースを一緒に見せるスポーツの一場面。

entries.prompt: Set a fictional 1920s race day in England. Show a spectator in an emerald dress and period hat looking toward the track. Cut to her gloves on the railing, then take a view wide enough to see horses passing at a distance. Keep the fabrics, muted light and crowd sounds consistent across the scene.

title.en: A Runner Crosses Four Worlds
title.ja: 四つの世界を走り抜ける

summary.en: Portal transitions preserve one runner’s direction and pace through several distinct environments.
summary.ja: ポータルを通るたび環境が変わっても、走る向きと速さを保つ。

entries.prompt: Keep a single tracking shot on a runner passing through a series of portals. Start in a metal corridor. Match the runner's stride into a dusty desert, then a frozen street and a rooftop lit by neon signs. Use echoes, wind and changes in light to mark each transition. Preserve the direction of travel and the timing of the steps as each world changes. Finish in a wide frame with the previous worlds visible behind the runner.

title.en: A Dog Bartender Shakes a Drink
title.ja: 犬のバーテンダーがシェーカーを振る

summary.en: A reference-led close-up comedy uses a shaker and a serious expression to carry the joke.
summary.ja: 開始画像を起点に、シェーカーと真剣な表情で見せるコメディ。

entries.prompt: Start with your own image of a fluffy white dog behind a walnut bar. Keep the same navy apron and warm light as the dog rests its front paws beside a metal shaker. Cut in closer when the lid goes on and the shaker starts rattling. Hold on the dog's very solemn expression before the finished drink slides into frame. Use synchronized clinks and counter sounds to sell the sequence.

title.en: A Dragon Lifts a Wooden Tub from the River
title.ja: ドラゴンが川から木のたらいを持ち上げる

summary.en: The jump from river height to an aerial wide shot makes a gentle dragon reveal feel large.
summary.ja: 川の高さから空撮に切り替え、穏やかなドラゴンの大きさを見せる。

entries.prompt: Follow a wooden tub drifting along a river in a misty mountain valley. Keep the camera low as the passenger steadies herself in the water. A large pink-and-white dragon glides alongside, lifts the tub slowly and carries it over the river. Pull out to an aerial view as the water drops away. Let the tub sway gently and support the change in height with wind and running water.

title.en: A Dark Stone on a Riverbank
title.ja: 川岸にある黒い石

summary.en: A restrained fantasy scene uses wet ground and an unusual prop to build attention.
summary.ja: 濡れた地面と不思議な小道具で静かなファンタジーの期待を作る。

entries.prompt: Set a misty riverbank at dusk with a single dark stone on the wet ground. Open at water level, then show a traveler noticing the object as the light changes very slightly around it. Cut close enough to see droplets and surface texture. Keep the surroundings quiet and let the water carry the scene.

title.en: A Good-Luck Surprise Backstage
title.ja: 舞台裏の小さな応援サプライズ

summary.en: A personal camera notices a small gesture just before a performance.
summary.ja: 出演前の小さな応援を手持ちカメラが見つける。

entries.prompt: Film a fictional backstage diary with a handheld phone. Follow a performer through a small preparation area until she notices a good-luck surprise left by the crew. Let the camera reframe naturally from the gift to her reaction. Keep surrounding stage sounds audible and end before she goes on.

title.en: One Continuous Canyon POV
title.ja: 赤い峡谷を抜ける一人称のワンカット

summary.en: A canyon sequence tests continuous point of view, wind and the sense of distance over water.
summary.ja: 峡谷を舞台に、途切れない視点と風、水面までの距離を表現する。

entries.prompt: Create a fictional action-film POV high above a desert river. Keep a single camera viewpoint as it follows the red-rock canyon and then drifts lower over the water. Use small body tilts and brief zooms to alternate between the rocky walls, the river and a boat waiting in the distance. Let the wind soften as the camera nears the water and end mid-motion as the waiting crew comes into view.

title.en: A Basketball Sequence from Half Court
title.ja: ハーフコートからのバスケットボール映像

summary.en: A wide setup and side tracking make the ball and movement easy to follow.
summary.ja: 広い入りと横の追い撮りでボールと動きを追いやすくする。

entries.prompt: Start wide on a fictional basketball player at half court under overhead arena lights. Push in slowly, then track from the side as the player dribbles and accelerates. Cut to the ball contacting the floor and return to a view showing the player’s path. Keep reflections and the ball position consistent.

title.en: Building a Bedroom Model One Brick at a Time
title.ja: 部屋でブロックの模型を組み立てる

summary.en: Time-lapse compresses building while maintaining the same desk layout.
summary.ja: 机の配置を保ち、組み立てを早回しで見せる。

entries.prompt: Animate a child at a desk assembling a small model from building bricks. Cut close to different pieces clicking together. Use time-lapse to advance the project while keeping the table and surrounding pieces in the same positions. Finish in a wider frame as the child looks proudly at the completed model.

title.en: A Market Lane in Old Osaka
title.ja: 昔の大阪の市場通り

summary.en: Shop signs, steam and bicycles give a narrow market lane period texture.
summary.ja: 看板、湯気、自転車で昔の細い市場通りを描く。

entries.prompt: Create a fictional market lane in 1920s Osaka. Follow a passerby past a wooden storefront, a food stall releasing steam and a bicycle against the wall. Cut close on handwritten signs and cloth, then widen enough to show the lane’s depth. Keep period objects in view and use a lightly textured analog look.

title.en: A Velvet Look in an Airport Terminal
title.ja: 空港ターミナルのベルベット衣装

summary.en: Moving fabric and repeated terminal geometry frame a fanciful fashion entrance.
summary.ja: 布の動きとターミナルの繰り返す形で幻想的な登場を見せる。

entries.prompt: Stage a fanciful fashion entrance in a modern airport terminal. Keep one fictional model in a black velvet and burgundy outfit as she moves through the long corridor. Let a lace train drift behind her and use a low camera to hold it against the floor reflections. Change to a wider view before the movement ends.

title.en: A Bicycle Courier’s Animated Delivery
title.ja: 自転車配達員を追うアニメ

summary.en: A street-level opening establishes scale before following a city courier.
summary.ja: 通りの高さで街を見せてから配達員を追う。

entries.prompt: Open the animated sequence low on a downtown avenue with buses and high buildings in the distance. Pick up a bicycle courier moving through the frame and follow from the side. Cut close to the wheel and a delivery bag, then widen to show how the route fits into the city. Use street ambience and steady forward motion.

title.en: A Fictional Camcorder Visit to Ancient Giza
title.ja: 架空の家庭用カメラで訪ねる古代ギザ

summary.en: A historical reconstruction pairs a distant building site and close worker details.
summary.ja: 歴史の再現を工事現場の引きと作業の手元で描く。

entries.prompt: Film a clearly fictional historical reconstruction of construction at Giza. Open on the vast site from a handheld viewpoint, then show workers moving stone from a safe distance and cut close to dust and tools. Keep period clothing and buildings consistent. Use soft tape texture as a stylistic device and let the physical scale build across the shots.

title.en: A Snorkeler’s View of the Caribbean
title.ja: シュノーケラーの視点で見るカリブ海

summary.en: A wrist and mask edge keep the underwater viewpoint anchored.
summary.ja: 腕とマスクの端で水中の一人称を保つ。

entries.prompt: Create a first-person view in clear shallow Caribbean water. Keep the wrist at one edge and the soft outline of a mask at the other while the camera glides past coral. Let fish cross the foreground as light moves over the sand. Use gentle floating motion and let bubbles mark each breath.

title.en: A Kitten at a Candlelit Table
title.ja: ろうそくの灯るテーブルの子猫

summary.en: The fantasy scene holds a close interaction at fingertip scale.
summary.ja: 指先の大きさで、幻想的な小さなやりとりを見せる。

entries.prompt: Set a fictional room around a wooden table and warm low light. Place a tiny orange-and-white character kitten near an adult’s hand. Hold a close view as the kitten leans toward a fingertip and pauses. Pull back gently to show the difference in scale and keep the candlelight soft.

title.en: Storms and Castles Inside Glass Bottles
title.ja: ガラス瓶の中の嵐と城

summary.en: The bottle stays in frame while tiny landscapes change inside it.
summary.ja: 瓶の画角を保ちながら、中の小さな風景が変わる。

entries.prompt: Frame a corked bottle under soft studio light. Show a tiny ship surrounded by dark waves inside the glass, then shift to a floating castle in another bottle at the same angle. Use reflections and the curved glass to establish scale, while keeping the miniature details readable. Let the outside table and light stay fixed.

title.en: The Curious Child and the Giant Ostrich Egg
title.ja: 好奇心いっぱいの子と巨大なダチョウの卵

summary.en: A large egg draws attention before the ostrich reveal.
summary.ja: 大きな卵に視線を集めてからダチョウを登場させる。

entries.prompt: Animate a fictional child encountering an oversized egg. Start from the child’s height and hold the egg beside her for scale. Cut closer as the shell shifts, then reveal the ostrich in a wide shot. Let the startled pause give way to a playful, gentle ending, keeping the nest in the same place throughout.

title.en: A Snowball Chase at the Winter Academy
title.ja: 冬の魔法学校の雪合戦

summary.en: Snow, archways and quick reactions drive a light animated chase.
summary.ja: 雪、石のアーチ、素早い反応で軽い追いかけっこを描く。

entries.prompt: Animate a winter courtyard at a fictional magic school. A snowball interrupts a stern character’s walk. Hold her surprise, then follow two pranksters through stone archways with quick side views. Use footprints and drifting snow to keep the route readable and end on a playful reaction rather than a confrontation.

title.en: A Bedroom Opens onto a New Universe
title.ja: 寝室が別の宇宙へ開く

summary.en: Alarm light and floating objects build into a full room transformation.
summary.ja: 目覚ましの光と浮かぶ物から部屋全体の変化へ広げる。

entries.prompt: Start in a quiet apartment before dawn as a futuristic clock gives off a soft light. Keep the camera moving slowly while the bedding begins to glow and small objects lift away from the floor. Let the walls unfold into geometric forms. End wider on the same space transformed, retaining the starting viewpoint and major furniture positions.

title.en: A Halloween Cat and the Moving Pumpkins
title.ja: ハロウィーンの猫と動くカボチャ

summary.en: A low camera makes the cat’s viewpoint and the pumpkin gag easy to read.
summary.ja: 低いカメラで猫の目線とカボチャの仕掛けを見せる。

entries.prompt: Set a playful fictional Halloween scene from a cat’s height. Open on pumpkins that appear still, then let one move just as the cat turns away. Follow a short comic pursuit through warm decorations and end on a pause as the cat notices the trick. Keep the tone light and the camera close to the ground.

title.en: Roasted Sweet Potatoes on a Snowy Night
title.ja: 雪の夜の焼き芋

summary.en: Warm charcoal and steam contrast with cool street light in a short food scene.
summary.ja: 冷たい街灯と、炭火や湯気の暖かさを対比させる。

entries.prompt: Track along a snowy Korean street at night toward a food cart with glowing charcoal. Move from a person approaching the stall to a close-up of the steam when a roasted sweet potato is opened. Let shop signs reflect in the wet pavement while the subject warms her hands and tastes it. End on the ember glow and her small smile, with snow still moving gently through the frame. Use street ambience and crackling charcoal.

title.en: A Running Shoe Reveal Cut on Footsteps
title.ja: 足音に合わせたランニングシューズの登場

summary.en: Hand and foot movements motivate fast cuts in an exercise-product spot.
summary.ja: 手と足の動きに合わせて素早く切り替える商品映像。

entries.prompt: Make a short clean running-shoe spot in soft daylight. Start with hands lifting an unbranded shoe, then cut to texture and to a foot stepping into it. Match the next cuts to a series of footsteps. Return to a clear side view of the footwear with steady colors and ordinary room sound.

title.en: Building a Cathedral in Miniature
title.ja: ミニチュアの大聖堂を組み立てる

summary.en: A build sequence moves from sketches and loose blocks to a finished architectural model.
summary.ja: 図面とばらばらのブロックから完成した建築模型までを見せる。

entries.prompt: Start in a bright architecture studio with drawings, a clock and a table of pale building blocks. Cut close to gloved hands assembling the base of a miniature cathedral. Use evenly spaced cuts as the arches and towers rise. Pause on the final ornament being placed, then pull back to show the completed model and the two builders. Keep the proportions of the structure steady and use soft side light to reveal its surface.

title.en: A Bedroom Hidden Inside a Giant Orange
title.ja: 巨大なオレンジの中に隠れた寝室

summary.en: The same orchard framing turns a fruit interior into a doorway.
summary.ja: 果樹園の画角を保ち、果物の中を入口に変える。

entries.prompt: In a sunny orchard, frame a fictional traveler beside an enormous orange. Let the fruit open to reveal its textured citrus interior. Keep the same point of view as that interior becomes the entrance to a softly lit bedroom. Hold the orchard around the edge of the doorway so the change is easy to follow.

title.en: A Cat Wins a Sumo Match
title.ja: 猫が相撲で勝つ日

summary.en: The crowd’s reaction sells an absurd sports scene filmed like a spontaneous phone clip.
summary.ja: 観客の反応が、偶然撮れたような猫の相撲映像を支える。

entries.prompt: Film a fictional bout from the edge of a crowded sumo ring. The unlikely contestant is a small cat that waits calmly while the spectators lean in. Frame the bout from between two shoulders, using a slightly late zoom and a moment of soft focus as the cat knocks the larger opponent off balance in a harmless comic tumble. Pause on the cat's steady gaze before the spectators burst into laughter and cheers.

title.en: Grandpa Watches the First Steps
title.ja: おじいちゃんが見守る初めの一歩

summary.en: Low angles and family reaction shots make a toddler’s first attempt at standing the comic beat.
summary.ja: 幼い子が立つ場面を低いカメラと家族のリアクションで見せる。

entries.prompt: Stage a warm 3D animated family scene in a living room. At carpet height, show a toddler playing with alphabet blocks while a grandfather leans down to see what she is doing. Let the toddler crawl over and rise unsteadily with a very serious expression. Cut to the parents sharing a laugh, then land on a close-up of the child grinning. Let a short pause just before the grin set the timing.

title.en: A Black Coupe Fashion Editorial
title.ja: 黒いクーペのファッション映像

summary.en: Quick cuts use the mirror, seats and bodywork of one car to frame a fashion editorial.
summary.ja: ミラー、シート、車体を素早く切り替える自動車ファッション映像。

entries.prompt: Create a short fashion editorial built around one glossy black coupe. Open tight on the rear-view mirror, then cut between the person in the driver's seat, a portrait from the rear seat and a wider hood-side pose. Move overhead to show the shape of the roof. Finish beside the open door. Keep the same outfit, car and lighting across the cuts. Use the interior and bodywork as frames for the subject.

title.en: Pizza Dough and a Mischievous Mouse
title.ja: ピザ生地といたずら好きなネズミ

summary.en: Animated kitchen comedy uses the dough toss and melted cheese as visual beats.
summary.ja: 生地を投げる動きと伸びるチーズで見せる台所のコメディ。

entries.prompt: In a warm animated pizza kitchen, show a chef tossing dough as flour hangs in the light. Cut to the toppings just as a small mouse appears at the edge of the counter. Let the chef pause and follow the mouse with his eyes before one exaggerated stretch of cheese ties the action together.

title.en: A Little Green Dragon Learns to Fly
title.ja: 小さな緑のドラゴンが飛べるようになる

summary.en: A wide sky and small practice movements establish the dragon’s progress.
summary.ja: 広い空と小さな練習の動きでドラゴンの成長を描く。

entries.prompt: Open on a green baby dragon watching other dragons fly over a broad hillside. Cut closer as it tries one small hop and lands short. Repeat with a little more lift and a longer wide shot. End with it finally crossing the grass a few feet above the ground, keeping its colors and proportions consistent.

title.en: A White Dragon in a Stone Hall
title.ja: 石造りの広間の白いドラゴン

summary.en: A slow head movement and a hand reaching out carry most of the scene.
summary.ja: ドラゴンがゆっくり頭を下げ、手が伸びる動きで見せる場面。

entries.prompt: Frame a person in a pale gown in a medieval stone hall with a large white dragon. Start wide enough to establish the height of the arches and wings. Allow the dragon to lower its head slowly, then move in on a hand reaching toward its scaled brow. Keep the movement gentle and let light catch the pale scales without losing the shadows of the hall. Finish with a still close-up of the two figures.

title.en: A White Can in a Night Kitchen
title.ja: 夜のキッチンに置いた白い缶

summary.en: Five quick shots turn an unbranded cylinder into the focus of a kitchen product spot.
summary.ja: 無地の白い缶を中心にした、短い五つのカット。

entries.prompt: Use your own image of an unbranded white can as the opening frame. In a dim home kitchen, cut from a medium shot of a person picking it up to a close-up of fingers around the rim. Shift the angle to catch a warm edge of light on the matte cylinder. Show it being set back down and end with a still packshot. Keep the can's proportions and plain surface consistent through each cut. Add short kitchen sounds and light film grain.

title.en: An Aircraft Reassembles into a Robot
title.ja: 飛行機がロボットへ組み替わる

summary.en: Mechanical parts turn and lock as the same aerial shot keeps moving.
summary.ja: 空撮の動きを保ったまま、機械部品が回転し組み合わさる。

entries.prompt: Track a fictional futuristic aircraft above a city. Let its panels rotate away from the original profile, then show separate assemblies locking into a robot silhouette. Keep the camera direction and distant skyline coherent as the shape changes. Use a wider angle after the transformation so the whole mechanism reads.

title.en: A Quiet Cup of Coffee
title.ja: ソファで味わう静かなコーヒー

summary.en: A sofa portrait uses a sip of coffee and a small expression change as the scene’s only action.
summary.ja: コーヒーの一口と小さな表情の変化で場面を見せる。

entries.prompt: Set a short portrait in a softly lit apartment. A woman in a cream sweater sits with both hands wrapped around a ceramic mug. Begin at medium distance, then move slowly closer as she looks down, cools the drink with a breath and takes one sip. Hold while she looks up and smiles. Keep window light steady and let the faint room tone carry the pause.

title.en: A Fictional Wave at the Waterfront
title.ja: 海沿いの街に迫る架空の大波

summary.en: A phone-camera opening gives way to wide shots of a fictional coastal flood.
summary.ja: スマートフォンの画角から、架空の海沿いの街を見渡す広い画角に移る。

entries.prompt: Stage a fictional disaster-film scene on an anonymous coastal waterfront. Begin close on a phone held toward an approaching swell. Cut wide enough to see the rise of water behind buildings, then follow two fictional adults moving away as foam reaches the road. Keep their direction readable across the change of angles. Finish on a wide frame with the height of the water clear against the seawall. Use the sound of rushing water and a muted city background.

title.en: A Windy Afternoon at the Window
title.ja: 風の強い午後の窓辺

summary.en: A MiniDV-style portrait uses scarf fabric and drifting leaves for movement.
summary.ja: スカーフと落ち葉の動きを使ったMiniDV風のポートレート。

entries.prompt: Frame an adult in a coat and knitted scarf by a window. Let the handheld camera edge a little closer as she turns and gives a small wave. Through the window, show leaves blowing across the street. Keep the light soft, colors slightly faded and nearby wind audible.

title.en: A Winter Homecoming Under the Stars
title.ja: 星空の下の冬の帰宅

summary.en: One tracking shot joins blue snow, a warm house and a family greeting.
summary.ja: 青い雪、暖かな家、家族の出迎えを一つの追い撮りでつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Track a fictional traveler in a heavy cloak on a snowy hillside at night. Keep a small house and its amber window visible against the starry blue sky. Move nearer as the door opens and a child comes out to greet him. Let the footprints, breath and light from the house carry the movement into the final embrace.

title.en: A Korean Train Journey in 1988
title.ja: 1988年、韓国の列車旅

summary.en: A faded home-video treatment connects a rural station, a carriage interior and the view from a moving train.
summary.ja: 駅、車内、車窓を色あせたホームビデオの質感でつなぐ。

entries.prompt: Shoot a fictional family travel film set in South Korea in the late 1980s. Begin on the platform as a blue-and-cream passenger train arrives and travelers board with woven bags. Move inside for the green seats, a newspaper turning and a snack seller passing through. Finish on rice paddies and distant hills sliding past the window. Use slightly uneven handheld framing, faded film colors and the sound of the rails. Keep modern objects out of frame.
